source.text: וְֽ֠הָיָה מִסְפַּ֤ר בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כְּח֣וֹל הַיָּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־יִמַּ֖ד וְלֹ֣א יִסָּפֵ֑ר וְֽ֠הָיָה בִּמְק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יֵאָמֵ֤ר לָהֶם֙ לֹֽא־עַמִּ֣י אַתֶּ֔ם יֵאָמֵ֥ר לָהֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י אֵֽל־חָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be [the] number of [the] sons of Israel like [the] sand of the sea, which not will be measured and not will be counted; and it will be in [the] place where it was said to them, Not my people [are] you, it will be said to them, Sons of [the] God living.

en.L: And the number of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel will be like the sand of the sea, which will not be measured and will not be counted; and it will be, in the place where it was said to them, "Not {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people [are] you," it will be said to them, "{{gender:Children|Sons}} of [the] living God."
en.B: Yet the number of the people of Israel will be like the sand of the sea, which no one can measure or count. In the very place where they were told, "You are not {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people," they will be told, "You are {{gender:children|sons}} of the living God."
en.R: But one day the people of Israel will be as many as the grains of sand by the sea. No one will be able to measure them or count them. In the same place where they were told, "You are not {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people," they will be called "{{gender:children|sons}} of the living God."

es.L: Y será el número de los hijos de Israel como la arena del mar, que no se puede medir ni contar; y sucederá que en el lugar donde se les dijo: «{{plural_you:Ustedes|Vosotros}} no {{plural_you:son|sois}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo», se les dirá: «Hijos del Dios viviente».
es.B: Pero el número de los israelitas será como la arena del mar, que nadie puede medir ni contar. En el mismo lugar donde se les dijo: «{{plural_you:Ustedes no son|Vosotros no sois}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo», se les dirá: «{{plural_you:Ustedes son|Vosotros sois}} hijos del Dios viviente».
es.R: Pero un día el pueblo de Israel será tan numeroso como los granos de arena a la orilla del mar. Nadie podrá medirlos ni contarlos. En el mismo lugar donde se les dijo: «{{plural_you:Ustedes no son|Vosotros no sois}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo», serán llamados «hijos del Dios viviente».

fr.L: Et le nombre des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël sera comme le sable de la mer, qui ne se mesure pas et ne se compte pas ; et il arrivera, dans le lieu où il leur était dit : « Vous [n’êtes] pas {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple », il leur sera dit : « {{gender:Enfants|Fils}} du Dieu vivant. »
fr.B: Pourtant, le nombre des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} sera comme le sable de la mer, que personne ne peut mesurer ni compter. Et là même où on leur disait : « Vous n’êtes pas {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple », on leur dira : « Vous êtes {{gender:enfants|fils}} du Dieu vivant. »
fr.R: Mais un jour, les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} seront aussi nombreux que les grains de sable au bord de la mer. Personne ne pourra les mesurer ni les compter. À l’endroit même où on leur disait : « Vous n’êtes pas {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple », on les appellera « {{gender:enfants|fils}} du Dieu vivant ».

ko.L: 그러나 이스라엘 자손의 수가 바다의 모래와 같아서, 재지도 못하고 세지도 못할 것이다. 그리고 그들에게 "너희는 내 백성이 아니다" 하고 말하던 곳에서, 그들에게 "살아 계신 하나님의 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들"이라고 말하게 될 것이다.
ko.B: 그러나 이스라엘 백성의 수는 바다의 모래처럼 많아져서, 아무도 재거나 셀 수 없을 것이다. 그들이 "너희는 내 백성이 아니다"라는 말을 들었던 바로 그곳에서, "너희는 살아 계신 하나님의 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들이다"라는 말을 듣게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 언젠가 이스라엘 백성은 바닷가의 모래알처럼 많아질 것이다. 아무도 그들을 재거나 셀 수 없을 것이다. 그들이 "너희는 내 백성이 아니다"라는 말을 들었던 바로 그곳에서, 그들은 "살아 계신 하나님의 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들"이라고 불릴 것이다.

vi.L: Và số con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ như cát biển, không thể đo và không thể đếm; và sẽ xảy ra, tại nơi người ta đã nói với họ: "Các ngươi không [phải là] dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}," thì người ta sẽ nói với họ: "[Các ngươi là] con cái của Đức Chúa Trời hằng sống."
vi.B: Thế nhưng số dân Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ như cát biển, không ai đo hay đếm được. Tại chính nơi người ta đã bảo họ: "Các ngươi không phải là dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}," người ta sẽ bảo họ: "Các ngươi là con cái của Đức Chúa Trời hằng sống."
vi.R: Nhưng một ngày kia, dân Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ đông như cát bờ biển. Không ai có thể đo hay đếm được. Tại chính nơi họ đã bị bảo: "Các ngươi không phải là dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}," họ sẽ được gọi là "con cái của Đức Chúa Trời hằng sống."

sw.L: Na hesabu ya wana wa Israeli itakuwa kama mchanga wa bahari, usiopimika wala usiohesabika; na itakuwa, mahali pale walipoambiwa, "Ninyi si watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}," wataambiwa, "[Ninyi ni] wana wa Mungu aliye hai."
sw.B: Hata hivyo hesabu ya watu wa Israeli itakuwa kama mchanga wa bahari, ambao hakuna awezaye kuupima wala kuuhesabu. Mahali palepale walipoambiwa, "Ninyi si watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}," wataambiwa, "Ninyi ni wana wa Mungu aliye hai."
sw.R: Lakini siku moja watu wa Israeli watakuwa wengi kama chembe za mchanga wa pwani. Hakuna atakayeweza kuwapima wala kuwahesabu. Mahali palepale walipoambiwa, "Ninyi si watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}," wataitwa "wana wa Mungu aliye hai."

decisions.choice: This verse is 2:1 in the Hebrew text, 1:10 in many Bibles
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text begins chapter 2 here, so that the promise of 2:1-3 opens the new chapter. Many Bibles end chapter 1 with this verse and the next, numbering them 1:10-11, and then begin chapter 2 with "Say to your brothers" (Hebrew 2:3), so their 2:1-23 is 2:3-25 here. Open Word Bible follows the numbering of the Hebrew text it translates, and Hosea is cited that way.

decisions.choice: like the sand of the sea: the promise to Abraham and Jacob
decisions.reason: God promised Abraham offspring as many as the sand on the seashore (Genesis 22:17) and repeated it to Jacob (Genesis 32:13). Right after the names of judgment, the old promise is restated: the people declared "not my people" will still become countless.

decisions.choice: in the place where: in the same place where they were disowned
decisions.reason: The words usually mean "in the place where". The place may be the land itself, or Jezreel (2:2). The same words can also mean "instead of" (as Isaiah 33:21 uses a similar phrase), giving "instead of being told 'You are not my people', they will be told ...". The sense is close either way: the name of rejection is replaced by a name of belonging.

decisions.choice: Romans 9:26 quotes this verse
decisions.reason: Paul quotes these words, as they stand in the Greek Old Testament, together with 2:25, and applies them to Gentiles whom God has called (Romans 9:24-26). In Hosea the promise is first to Israel, the people who had been named "not my people". The verse is also behind 1 Peter 2:10.

decisions.choice: children of the living God: a name of belonging that replaces "not my people"
decisions.reason: Israel is called the LORD's son (Exodus 4:22; Hosea 11:1) and his children (Deuteronomy 14:1). "The living God" sets him against idols that have no life, the Baals of chapter 2. The word is "sons", which here includes the whole people, men and women alike.

decisions.choice: children / sons (gender setting); people of Israel (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Sons of Israel" and "sons of the living God" mean the whole people, so they take the gender setting. Balanced and Readable say "the people of Israel" in the first clause. Literal keeps the Hebrew order "Not my people are you".

decisions.choice: "hijos del Dios viviente", with no gender span
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets and as Romans 9:26 has it in Spanish: "hijos" already includes daughters, so Spanish needs no gender setting here.

decisions.choice: "[[Ustedes no son|Vosotros no sois]] mi pueblo"; "hijos del Dios viviente"
decisions.reason: Worded as the Spanish of Romans 9:26, which quotes this verse, since the Hebrew and the Greek agree here.

decisions.choice: "Vous n'êtes pas mon peuple" and "enfants du Dieu vivant" (gender alternative "fils"), the published French Romans 9:26 wording
alternatives: "fils du Dieu vivant" as the default
decisions.reason: Romans 9:26 quotes this verse and the Hebrew means the same, so the French keeps the published New Testament's key words at each level, as the term sheet asks.

decisions.choice: "les Israélites" with "fils d'Israël" as the gender alternative (B, R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet words "the sons of Israel" as "les {{gender:Israélites|fils d'Israël}}" at Balanced and Readable, as the Pentateuch; the English Balanced and Readable say "the people of Israel" without a setting, so the French has a gender span the English lacks.

decisions.choice: "con cái của Đức Chúa Trời hằng sống"; "con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên" (L)
decisions.reason: The wording of Romans 9:26, which quotes this verse. "Con cái" and "con cháu" already include sons and daughters, so the English gender spans have no Vietnamese counterpart, as in the published histories ("con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên").

decisions.choice: "살아 계신 하나님의 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들", with the gender span as in Romans 9:26
decisions.reason: Romans 9:26 quotes this verse; the Korean keeps its wording and its span so the quotation is visible. "The sons of Israel" is 이스라엘 자손 / 백성 (L / B, R), which needs no span.

decisions.choice: Hosea follows the Hebrew verse numbers (2:1–25), as the English does
decisions.reason: Korean Bibles number this verse 1:10; the shared footnote gives the other numbering.

decisions.choice: "wana" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Wana" covers sons and daughters alike, so the English children/sons setting has nothing to change in Swahili; no gender span is written in Hosea and Joel. "wana wa Mungu aliye hai" is the wording of Romans 9:26, which quotes this verse.

decisions.choice: "Mungu aliye hai"
decisions.reason: The living God, as Romans 9:26 and Daniel 6:21 (term sheet).

source.text: וְ֠נִקְבְּצוּ בְּנֵֽי־יְהוּדָ֤ה וּבְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו וְשָׂמ֥וּ לָהֶ֛ם רֹ֥אשׁ אֶחָ֖ד וְעָל֣וּ מִן־הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּ֥י גָד֖וֹל י֥וֹם יִזְרְעֶֽאל׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be gathered [the] sons of Judah and [the] sons of Israel together, and they will appoint for themselves head one, and they will go up from the land, for great [will be the] day of Jezreel.

en.L: And there will be gathered the {{gender:children|sons}} of Judah and the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel together, and they will set over themselves one head, and they will go up out of the land; because great [will be] the day of Jezreel.
en.B: The people of Judah and the people of Israel will be gathered together. They will appoint one leader for themselves and will go up out of the land, for the day of Jezreel will be great.
en.R: The people of Judah and the people of Israel will come together again. They will choose one leader for themselves, and they will go up out of the land. The day of Jezreel will be a great day!

es.L: Y los hijos de Judá y los hijos de Israel serán reunidos juntos, y se pondrán una sola cabeza, y subirán de la tierra; porque grande [será] el día de Jezreel.
es.B: Los habitantes de Judá y los de Israel serán reunidos. Se nombrarán un solo jefe y subirán de la tierra, porque el día de Jezreel será grande.
es.R: El pueblo de Judá y el pueblo de Israel volverán a unirse. Escogerán un solo jefe y subirán de la tierra. ¡El día de Jezreel será un gran día!

fr.L: Et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Juda et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël seront rassemblés ensemble, et ils établiront sur eux une seule tête, et ils monteront hors du pays ; car grand [sera] le jour de Jizreël.
fr.B: Le peuple de Juda et le peuple d’Israël seront rassemblés. Ils se donneront un seul chef et ils monteront hors du pays, car grand sera le jour de Jizreël.
fr.R: Le peuple de Juda et le peuple d’Israël se réuniront de nouveau. Ils choisiront un seul chef et ils monteront hors du pays. Le jour de Jizreël sera un grand jour !

ko.L: 유다 자손과 이스라엘 자손이 함께 모일 것이다. 그들이 자기들 위에 한 우두머리를 세우고 그 땅에서 올라올 것이다. 이스르엘의 날이 클 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 유다 백성과 이스라엘 백성이 함께 모일 것이다. 그들은 한 지도자를 세우고 그 땅에서 올라올 것이다. 이스르엘의 날이 위대할 것이기 때문이다.
ko.R: 유다 백성과 이스라엘 백성이 다시 하나로 모일 것이다. 그들은 자기들을 이끌 지도자 한 사람을 뽑고, 그 땅에서 올라올 것이다. 이스르엘의 날은 위대한 날이 될 것이다!

vi.L: Con cháu Giu-đa và con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ được nhóm họp lại với nhau, và họ sẽ lập cho mình một người đứng đầu, và họ sẽ đi lên khỏi xứ; vì ngày của Gít-rê-ên sẽ lớn lao.
vi.B: Dân Giu-đa và dân Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ được tập hợp lại với nhau. Họ sẽ lập một người lãnh đạo cho mình và sẽ từ trong xứ đi lên, vì ngày của Gít-rê-ên sẽ thật lớn lao.
vi.R: Dân Giu-đa và dân Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ lại hiệp làm một. Họ sẽ chọn một người lãnh đạo cho mình, và họ sẽ từ trong xứ đi lên. Ngày của Gít-rê-ên sẽ là một ngày trọng đại!

sw.L: Na wana wa Yuda na wana wa Israeli watakusanywa pamoja, nao watajiwekea kichwa kimoja, nao watapanda kutoka katika nchi; kwa maana siku ya Yezreeli [itakuwa] kuu.
sw.B: Watu wa Yuda na watu wa Israeli watakusanywa pamoja. Watajichagulia kiongozi mmoja na kupanda kutoka katika nchi, kwa maana siku ya Yezreeli itakuwa kuu.
sw.R: Watu wa Yuda na watu wa Israeli wataungana tena. Watajichagulia kiongozi mmoja, nao watapanda kutoka katika nchi. Siku ya Yezreeli itakuwa siku kuu!

decisions.choice: Judah and Israel gathered together under one head: the divided kingdoms reunited
decisions.reason: Israel and Judah had been two kingdoms since the death of Solomon (1 Kings 12). The promise is that they will be one people again under a single leader. The word is "head", not "king"; 3:5 names the king as "David their king". Ezekiel 37:15-24 makes the same promise with two sticks joined into one.

decisions.choice: go up from the land: the sense is uncertain
alternatives: come up out of the land of exile
decisions.reason: The phrase can be read in several ways. (1) They will come up out of the land of their exile, as Israel once came up out of Egypt (2:17). (2) They will spring up from the ground like a crop, which suits the name Jezreel, "God sows" (2:24-25). (3) They will take possession of the land; Exodus 1:10 uses the same words, where Pharaoh fears the Israelites will "go up from the land", with a sense that is itself debated. The translation keeps the Hebrew words, which leave the choice open.

decisions.choice: great will be the day of Jezreel: the name now promises good
decisions.reason: In 1:4-5 Jezreel was a place of bloodshed and defeat. Here "the day of Jezreel" is a day of gathering, and the name's meaning, "God sows", comes to the front: God will plant his people again (2:24-25).

decisions.choice: This verse is 2:2 in the Hebrew text, 1:11 in many Bibles
decisions.reason: See 2:1. Bibles that number this verse 1:11 begin chapter 2 with the next verse.

decisions.choice: appoint one leader (B); choose one leader (R)
decisions.reason: "Head" means a leader here. Balanced and Readable say "leader"; Literal keeps "head". Readable adds "again" to "come together", which the promise implies after the division of the kingdoms (m1).

decisions.choice: "un solo jefe"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "one head" is a leader, not a king by title; "jefe" keeps the plain sense at Balanced and Readable, as the English "leader".

source.text: אִמְר֥וּ לַאֲחֵיכֶ֖ם עַמִּ֑י וְלַאֲחֽוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם רֻחָֽמָה׃

records.literal_gloss: Say to your brothers, My people, and to your sisters, She is shown compassion.

en.L: Say to your brothers, "Ammi," \q and to your sisters, "Ruhamah."
en.B: Say to your brothers, "My People," \q and to your sisters, "Shown Compassion."
en.R: Call your brothers "My People." \q Call your sisters "Shown Compassion."

es.L: {{plural_you:Digan|Decid}} a {{plural_you:sus hermanos|vuestros hermanos}}: «Ammi», \q y a {{plural_you:sus hermanas|vuestras hermanas}}: «Ruhama».
es.B: {{plural_you:Digan|Decid}} a {{plural_you:sus hermanos|vuestros hermanos}}: «Mi Pueblo», \q y a {{plural_you:sus hermanas|vuestras hermanas}}: «Compadecida».
es.R: {{plural_you:Llamen|Llamad}} a {{plural_you:sus hermanos|vuestros hermanos}} «Mi Pueblo». \q {{plural_you:Llamen|Llamad}} a {{plural_you:sus hermanas|vuestras hermanas}} «Compadecida».

fr.L: Dites à vos frères : « Ammi », \q et à vos sœurs : « Rouhama ».
fr.B: Dites à vos frères : « Mon-Peuple », \q et à vos sœurs : « Compassion-Reçue ».
fr.R: Appelez vos frères « Mon-Peuple ». \q Appelez vos sœurs « Compassion-Reçue ».

ko.L: 너희 형제들에게 "암미"라고 말하고, \q 너희 자매들에게 "루하마"라고 말하여라.
ko.B: 너희 형제들에게 "내 백성"이라고 하고, \q 너희 자매들에게 "긍휼 받음"이라고 하여라.
ko.R: 너희 형제들을 "내 백성"이라고 불러라. \q 너희 자매들을 "긍휼 받음"이라고 불러라.

vi.L: Hãy nói với anh em các ngươi: "Am-mi," \q và với chị em các ngươi: "Ru-ha-ma."
vi.B: Hãy nói với anh em các ngươi: "Dân Ta," \q và với chị em các ngươi: "Được Thương Xót."
vi.R: Hãy gọi anh em mình là "Dân Ta." \q Hãy gọi chị em mình là "Được Thương Xót."

sw.L: Waambieni ndugu zenu, "Ami," \q na dada zenu, "Ruhama."
sw.B: Waambieni ndugu zenu, "Watu Wangu," \q na dada zenu, "Aliyehurumiwa."
sw.R: Waiteni ndugu zenu "Watu Wangu." \q Waiteni dada zenu "Aliyehurumiwa."

decisions.choice: This verse is 2:3 in the Hebrew text, 2:1 in many Bibles
decisions.reason: Bibles that number Hebrew 2:1-2 as 1:10-11 begin their chapter 2 here, so Hebrew 2:3-25 is their 2:1-23. In the Hebrew, this verse closes the promise of 2:1-2; in those Bibles it opens the speech that follows.

decisions.choice: Ammi, "my people"; Ruhamah, "shown compassion": the children's names without the "not"
decisions.reason: The names Lo-ammi (1:9) and Lo-ruhamah (1:6) return with "not" taken away. Ammi means "my people"; Ruhamah means "she is shown compassion". The reversal promised in 2:1 is put into words the people can say to one another.

decisions.choice: say ... your brothers ... your sisters: the people of Israel are told to call one another by the new names
decisions.reason: "Say" and "your" are plural. The people are addressed, perhaps as the children of the mother of 2:4. Each is to call the others by the names of restored belonging. Some read the verse as the opening of the next section, where the children are told to bring a case against their mother; the Hebrew chapter places it at the end of the promise.

decisions.choice: the new names behind Romans 9:25 and 1 Peter 2:10
decisions.reason: The renaming that begins here is completed in 2:25, the verse Paul quotes in Romans 9:25. 1 Peter 2:10 also uses it: "once not a people, now God's people". See 2:25.

decisions.choice: My People; Shown Compassion (B, R); Ammi; Ruhamah (L)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable translate the names, as they do Not My People and No Compassion in chapter 1; Literal keeps the Hebrew names with their meaning in the footnote (m2). Readable says "Call" for "Say to", which is what the verse asks.

decisions.choice: "Ammi", "Ruhama" (L); "Mi Pueblo", "Compadecida" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The names of 1:6 and 1:9 without the "not": Literal keeps the Hebrew forms, Balanced and Readable the translated names of chapter 1. Here the names are called out, so they take quotation marks.

decisions.choice: plural imperative "[[Digan|Decid]]"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew command is plural, addressed to the people of Israel, so it takes the plural_you span.

decisions.choice: "Ammi", "Rouhama" (L); "Mon-Peuple", "Compassion-Reçue" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The names of 1:6 and 1:9 without their "not", written as the same kind of hyphenated proper names so the reversal can be seen.

records.literal_gloss: Contend with your mother, contend, for she not [is] my wife, and I not [am] her husband; and let her remove her prostitutions from her face, and her adulteries from between her breasts,

en.L: Contend with your mother, contend, \q because she [is] not {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wife, and I [am] not her husband, \q and let her remove her prostitutions from her face \q and her adulteries from between her breasts,
en.B: Bring a charge against your mother, bring a charge, \q because she is not {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wife, and I am not her husband. \q She must put away her prostitution from her face \q and her adultery from between her breasts,
en.R: Accuse your mother! Accuse her! \q She is not {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wife, and I am not her husband. \q She must stop showing herself off as a prostitute \q and giving her body to other men.

es.L: {{plural_you:Contiendan|Contended}} con {{plural_you:su madre|vuestra madre}}, {{plural_you:contiendan|contended}}, \q porque ella no [es] {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} esposa, y yo no [soy] su marido, \q y que quite de su rostro sus prostituciones \q y sus adulterios de entre sus pechos,
es.B: {{plural_you:Presenten|Presentad}} cargos contra {{plural_you:su madre|vuestra madre}}, {{plural_you:presenten|presentad}} cargos, \q porque ella no es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} esposa, y yo no soy su marido. \q Que aparte de su rostro su prostitución \q y sus adulterios de entre sus pechos,
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Acusen|Acusad}} a {{plural_you:su madre|vuestra madre}}! ¡{{plural_you:Acúsenla|Acusadla}}! \q Ella no es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} esposa, y yo no soy su marido. \q Tiene que dejar de exhibirse como una prostituta \q y de entregar su cuerpo a otros hombres.

fr.L: Plaidez contre votre mère, plaidez, \q car elle [n’est] pas {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} femme, et moi [je ne suis] pas son mari, \q et qu’elle ôte ses prostitutions de son visage \q et ses adultères d’entre ses seins,
fr.B: Portez plainte contre votre mère, portez plainte, \q car elle n’est pas {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} femme, et je ne suis pas son mari. \q Qu’elle ôte de son visage sa prostitution \q et d’entre ses seins son adultère,
fr.R: Accusez votre mère ! Accusez-la ! \q Elle n’est pas {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} femme, et je ne suis pas son mari. \q Qu’elle arrête de s’exhiber comme une prostituée \q et de donner son corps à d’autres hommes.

ko.L: 너희 어머니를 고발하여라, 고발하여라. \q 그 여자는 내 아내가 아니고, 나는 그 여자의 남편이 아니기 때문이다. \q 그 여자는 자기 얼굴에서 음행을 없애고 \q 자기 젖가슴 사이에서 간음을 없애야 한다.
ko.B: 너희 어머니를 고소하여라, 고소하여라. \q 그 여자는 내 아내가 아니고, 나는 그 여자의 남편이 아니다. \q 그 여자는 얼굴에서 음행의 흔적을 지우고 \q 젖가슴 사이에서 간음의 표를 없애야 한다.
ko.R: 너희 어머니를 고발하여라! 고발하여라! \q 그 여자는 더 이상 내 아내가 아니고, 나는 그 여자의 남편이 아니다. \q 그 여자는 창녀처럼 자기를 꾸미고 다니는 일을 그만두고 \q 다른 남자들에게 몸을 내주는 일을 그만두어야 한다.

vi.L: Hãy tranh tụng với mẹ các ngươi, hãy tranh tụng, \q vì nàng không [phải là] vợ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không [phải là] chồng nàng; \q và hãy để nàng cất bỏ sự đàng điếm khỏi mặt nàng \q và sự ngoại tình khỏi giữa ngực nàng,
vi.B: Hãy buộc tội mẹ các ngươi, hãy buộc tội nàng, \q vì nàng không phải là vợ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không phải là chồng nàng. \q Nàng phải cất bỏ vẻ lăng loàn khỏi mặt mình \q và sự ngoại tình khỏi giữa ngực mình,
vi.R: Hãy tố cáo mẹ các ngươi! Hãy tố cáo nàng! \q Nàng không phải là vợ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không phải là chồng nàng. \q Nàng phải thôi phô bày mình như gái điếm \q và thôi trao thân cho những người đàn ông khác.

sw.L: Shindaneni na mama yenu, shindaneni, \q kwa maana yeye si mke {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} si mume wake, \q na auondoe ukahaba wake usoni pake \q na uzinzi wake kati ya matiti yake,
sw.B: Mfungulieni mama yenu mashtaka, mfungulieni mashtaka, \q kwa sababu yeye si mke {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} si mume wake. \q Ni lazima auondoe ukahaba usoni pake \q na uzinzi wake kati ya matiti yake,
sw.R: Mshtakini mama yenu! Mshtakini! \q Yeye si mke {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} si mume wake. \q Ni lazima aache kujionyesha kama kahaba \q na kuwapa wanaume wengine mwili wake.

decisions.choice: the LORD speaks as the husband; the mother is Israel, the children are her people
decisions.reason: From here to 2:25 the LORD speaks ("declares the LORD", 2:15, 18, 23). Hosea's marriage gives the picture: the LORD is the husband, the nation is the wife and mother, and the people are her children, called to take their stand against their mother's ways. At times the poem speaks of the woman and at times of the land (2:5, 11).

decisions.choice: contend: bring a case against, accuse
decisions.reason: The verb is used for a legal dispute, a charge brought in court (Isaiah 3:13; Micah 6:1-2). The children are called to accuse their mother, joining their father's case against her.

decisions.choice: she is not my wife, and I am not her husband: the marriage is broken by her unfaithfulness
decisions.reason: The words sound like a formula of divorce. Yet the aim of what follows is not to end the marriage but to bring the wife back (2:9, 16-22). The sentence states how things stand: by her unfaithfulness she has broken the bond.

decisions.choice: prostitution from her face, adulteries from between her breasts: marks of unfaithfulness on her body
decisions.reason: This may refer to things worn: face paint, jewelry, or tokens of other gods worn on the face and between the breasts (compare Genesis 38:15; Jeremiah 4:30; Hosea 2:15). Or it may be a vivid way of naming the body given to others. Either way she is told to put away all that marks her unfaithfulness.

decisions.choice: the sentence runs on into 2:5
decisions.reason: "Let her remove" is followed by "or I will strip her" (2:5): the warning gives the reason for the demand.

decisions.choice: Bring a charge against (B); Accuse (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "contend with". Balanced and Readable give the legal sense (m2).

decisions.choice: She must stop showing herself off as a prostitute and giving her body to other men
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what the images of face and breasts stand for (m4) without making them cruder than the Hebrew, as the terms note asks for the marriage chapters. Readable ends the sentence here; 2:5 begins with "If she does not".

decisions.choice: "Contiendan" (L); "Presenten cargos" (B); "Acusen" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is a legal one, bringing a case against someone; Literal keeps "contender", Balanced and Readable say it in court language, as the English levels do.

decisions.choice: "Plaidez contre" (L), "Portez plainte contre" (B), "Accusez" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is a legal one, to bring a case; each level says it in a register of its own, as the English does.

decisions.choice: God's oracles in Hosea take no quotation marks; words quoted inside them (the people's or the woman's) take « », with “ ” only inside those
alternatives: quotation marks around the whole oracle
decisions.reason: As the term sheet sets for the prophets, following the English: the prophet's poetry and God's own speech stand unquoted.

decisions.choice: Israel as the wife is "nàng"; her children are "các ngươi"
decisions.reason: As the terms note settles, a woman standing for the people (Zion, the women of Ezekiel 16 and 23, and Hosea's wife Israel) is "nàng" in the third person at every level; her children, the people, are addressed as "các ngươi" in rebuke.

decisions.choice: God speaks as the husband in 해라체, with "나"; the mother is "그 여자", never "그녀"
decisions.reason: The prophets' rule for a city or people pictured as a woman: Korean repeats the noun or uses "그 여자" rather than the written pronoun "그녀", which the published prophets do not use.

decisions.choice: "Mfungulieni mashtaka" (B); "Mshtakini" (R)
decisions.reason: The courtroom sense of *riv* (m2); Literal keeps the plain verb "shindaneni" (contend).

source.text: פֶּן־אַפְשִׁיטֶ֣נָּה עֲרֻמָּ֔ה וְהִ֨צַּגְתִּ֔יהָ כְּי֖וֹם הִוָּֽלְדָ֑הּ וְשַׂמְתִּ֣יהָ כַמִּדְבָּ֗ר וְשַׁתִּ֨הָ֙ כְּאֶ֣רֶץ צִיָּ֔ה וַהֲמִתִּ֖יהָ בַּצָּמָֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: Lest I strip her naked and set her as [the] day she was born, and make her like the wilderness, and set her like a land of dryness, and kill her with thirst.

en.L: lest I strip her naked \q and set her [out] as on the day she was born, \q and make her like the wilderness, and set her like a land of drought, \q and kill her with thirst.
en.B: or I will strip her naked \q and leave her as bare as on the day she was born. \q I will make her like a wilderness, turn her into a parched land, \q and let her die of thirst.
en.R: If she does not, I will tear off her clothes \q and leave her as naked as the day she was born. \q I will make her like a desert, like a dry land, \q and she will die of thirst.

es.L: no sea que la desnude por completo \q y la deje como el día en que nació, \q y la ponga como el desierto, y la deje como tierra de sequía, \q y la mate de sed.
es.B: o la dejaré desnuda, \q tan desnuda como el día en que nació. \q La volveré como un desierto, la convertiré en tierra reseca, \q y la dejaré morir de sed.
es.R: Si no lo hace, le arrancaré la ropa \q y la dejaré tan desnuda como el día en que nació. \q La dejaré como un desierto, como una tierra seca, \q y morirá de sed.

fr.L: de peur que je ne la dépouille toute nue \q et ne l’expose comme au jour où elle est née, \q que je ne la rende pareille au désert, que je ne la mette comme une terre de sécheresse, \q et ne la fasse mourir de soif.
fr.B: sinon je la dépouillerai toute nue \q et je la laisserai aussi nue qu’au jour de sa naissance. \q Je la rendrai semblable à un désert, je ferai d’elle une terre desséchée, \q et je la laisserai mourir de soif.
fr.R: Sinon, je lui arracherai ses vêtements \q et je la laisserai aussi nue que le jour de sa naissance. \q Je la rendrai pareille à un désert, à une terre sèche, \q et elle mourra de soif.

ko.L: 그렇지 않으면 내가 그 여자의 옷을 벗겨 알몸으로 만들고, \q 그 여자가 태어나던 날처럼 내놓을 것이다. \q 그 여자를 광야처럼 만들고 메마른 땅처럼 되게 하여, \q 목말라 죽게 할 것이다.
ko.B: 그렇지 않으면 내가 그 여자를 발가벗겨 \q 태어나던 날처럼 벌거숭이로 내버려 두겠다. \q 그 여자를 광야처럼 만들고 바싹 마른 땅이 되게 하여 \q 목말라 죽게 하겠다.
ko.R: 그렇게 하지 않으면 나는 그 여자의 옷을 찢어 벗기고 \q 태어나던 날처럼 벌거벗은 채로 내버려 두겠다. \q 그 여자를 사막처럼, 메마른 땅처럼 만들겠다. \q 그러면 그 여자는 목말라 죽을 것이다.

vi.L: kẻo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lột trần nàng \q và để nàng [trơ trụi] như ngày nàng được sinh ra, \q và làm cho nàng như hoang mạc, và đặt nàng như đất khô hạn, \q và giết nàng bằng cơn khát.
vi.B: nếu không, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lột trần nàng \q và để nàng trần truồng như ngày nàng mới sinh ra. \q Ta sẽ làm cho nàng như hoang mạc, biến nàng thành đất khô cằn, \q và để nàng chết khát.
vi.R: Nếu nàng không chịu, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ xé bỏ áo quần nàng \q và để nàng trần truồng như ngày mới sinh. \q Ta sẽ làm cho nàng như sa mạc, như đất khô cằn, \q và nàng sẽ chết khát.

sw.L: nisije nikamvua nguo akabaki uchi, \q na kumweka kama siku ile alipozaliwa, \q na kumfanya kama nyika, na kumweka kama nchi ya ukame, \q na kumwua kwa kiu.
sw.B: la sivyo nitamvua nguo zote \q na kumwacha uchi kama siku aliyozaliwa. \q Nitamfanya kama nyika, nimgeuze kuwa nchi kavu, \q na kumwacha afe kwa kiu.
sw.R: Asipofanya hivyo, nitamvua nguo zake \q na kumwacha uchi kama siku aliyozaliwa. \q Nitamfanya kama jangwa, kama nchi kavu, \q naye atakufa kwa kiu.

decisions.choice: strip her naked: the public shaming of an unfaithful wife
decisions.reason: A husband was to provide his wife's clothing (Exodus 21:10). To strip her is to take back what he gave and to shame her openly, a picture the prophets use for a city's disgrace (Jeremiah 13:26; Ezekiel 16:37-39). "As on the day she was born" recalls the people's beginnings, when they had nothing (compare Ezekiel 16:4-7).

decisions.choice: like the wilderness ... a land of drought ... thirst: the woman pictured as a land without rain
decisions.reason: The image moves from the wife to the land she stands for. The people credited Baal with rain and crops (2:7, 10). The LORD will show who gives them by holding back the rain, until the land is like a desert.

decisions.choice: If she does not
decisions.reason: Readable begins a new sentence with what "lest" means: if she does not put away her unfaithfulness (2:4).

source.text: וְאֶת־בָּנֶ֖יהָ לֹ֣א אֲרַחֵ֑ם כִּֽי־בְנֵ֥י זְנוּנִ֖ים הֵֽמָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And her children not I will have compassion on, for children of prostitutions [are] they.

en.L: And on her children I will not have compassion, \q for they [are] children of prostitution.
en.B: I will not show compassion to her children, \q because they are children born of promiscuity.
en.R: I will not show compassion to her children, \q because they were born of unfaithfulness.

es.L: Y de sus hijos no tendré compasión, \q porque [son] hijos de prostitución.
es.B: No tendré compasión de sus hijos, \q porque son hijos nacidos de la promiscuidad.
es.R: No tendré compasión de sus hijos, \q porque nacieron de la infidelidad.

fr.L: Et de ses enfants je n’aurai pas compassion, \q car ils [sont] des enfants de prostitution.
fr.B: Je n’aurai pas compassion de ses enfants, \q car ce sont des enfants nés de la débauche.
fr.R: Je n’aurai pas de compassion pour ses enfants, \q parce qu’ils sont nés de l’infidélité.

ko.L: 그리고 그 여자의 자식들을 내가 긍휼히 여기지 않겠다. \q 그들은 음행의 자식들이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 나는 그 여자의 자식들도 긍휼히 여기지 않겠다. \q 그들은 음란한 가운데 태어난 자식들이기 때문이다.
ko.R: 나는 그 여자의 자식들도 긍휼히 여기지 않겠다. \q 그들은 신실하지 않은 가운데 태어났기 때문이다.

vi.L: Và các con của nàng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không thương xót, \q vì chúng [là] con cái đàng điếm.
vi.B: Ta sẽ không tỏ lòng thương xót các con của nàng, \q vì chúng là những đứa con sinh ra từ sự lăng loàn.
vi.R: Ta sẽ không thương xót các con của nàng, \q vì chúng được sinh ra từ sự không chung thủy.

sw.L: Na watoto wake sitawahurumia, \q kwa maana wao [ni] watoto wa ukahaba.
sw.B: Sitawahurumia watoto wake, \q kwa sababu ni watoto waliozaliwa katika uasherati.
sw.R: Sitawahurumia watoto wake, \q kwa sababu walizaliwa katika hali ya kutokuwa mwaminifu.

decisions.choice: I will not have compassion: the name No Compassion (1:6) applied to all her children
decisions.reason: The verb is the one in the daughter's name. What was said through one child's name is now said of all the mother's children: the people as well as the nation.

decisions.choice: children of prostitution: as in 1:2
decisions.reason: The phrase repeats the words of the command to Hosea (1:2). The children share their mother's character; the next verse gives the reason.

decisions.choice: children born of promiscuity (B); born of unfaithfulness (R)
decisions.reason: The same wording as 1:2 at each level.

source.text: כִּ֤י זָֽנְתָה֙ אִמָּ֔ם הֹבִ֖ישָׁה הֽוֹרָתָ֑ם כִּ֣י אָמְרָ֗ה אֵלְכָ֞ה אַחֲרֵ֤י מְאַהֲבַי֙ נֹתְנֵ֤י לַחְמִי֙ וּמֵימַ֔י צַמְרִ֣י וּפִשְׁתִּ֔י שַׁמְנִ֖י וְשִׁקּוּיָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: For has prostituted herself their mother; has acted shamefully she who conceived them; for she said, I will go after my lovers, [who] give my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, my oil and my drinks.

en.L: For their mother has prostituted herself; \q she who conceived them has acted shamefully. \q For she said, "Let me go after my lovers, givers of my bread and my water, \q my wool and my flax, \q my oil and my drinks."
en.B: Their mother has prostituted herself; \q she who conceived them has behaved shamefully. \q For she said, "I will follow my lovers, who give me my food and water, \q my wool and flax, \q my oil and drink."
en.R: Their mother has been unfaithful. \q She has done shameful things. \q She said, "I will go after my lovers. They give me my food and my water, \q my wool and linen, \q my olive oil and my drinks."

es.L: Porque su madre se ha prostituido; \q la que los concibió ha obrado vergonzosamente. \q Porque dijo: «Iré tras mis amantes, que me dan mi pan y mi agua, \q mi lana y mi lino, \q mi aceite y mi bebida».
es.B: Su madre se ha prostituido; \q la que los concibió se ha portado de forma vergonzosa. \q Pues dijo: «Seguiré a mis amantes, que me dan mi comida y mi agua, \q mi lana y mi lino, \q mi aceite y mi bebida».
es.R: Su madre ha sido infiel. \q Ha hecho cosas vergonzosas. \q Dijo: «Iré tras mis amantes. Ellos me dan mi comida y mi agua, \q mi lana y mi lino, \q mi aceite de oliva y mis bebidas».

fr.L: Car leur mère s’est prostituée ; \q celle qui les a conçus s’est couverte de honte. \q Car elle a dit : « Je veux aller après mes amants, qui donnent mon pain et mon eau, \q ma laine et mon lin, \q mon huile et mes boissons. »
fr.B: Leur mère s’est prostituée ; \q celle qui les a conçus s’est conduite de façon honteuse. \q Car elle a dit : « Je suivrai mes amants, qui me donnent ma nourriture et mon eau, \q ma laine et mon lin, \q mon huile et ma boisson. »
fr.R: Leur mère a été infidèle. \q Elle a fait des choses honteuses. \q Elle a dit : « Je vais suivre mes amants. Ils me donnent ma nourriture et mon eau, \q ma laine et mon lin, \q mon huile d’olive et mes boissons. »

ko.L: 그들의 어머니가 음행했고, \q 그들을 잉태한 여자가 부끄러운 짓을 했다. \q 그 여자가 말했기 때문이다. "내 애인들을 따라가겠다. 그들이 내 빵과 내 물, \q 내 양털과 내 삼, \q 내 기름과 내 마실 것을 주는 자들이다."
ko.B: 그들의 어머니는 음행을 저질렀고, \q 그들을 잉태한 여자는 부끄러운 짓을 했다. \q 그 여자는 이렇게 말했다. "나는 내 애인들을 따라가겠다. 그들이 나에게 먹을 것과 물, \q 양털과 삼, \q 기름과 마실 것을 준다."
ko.R: 그들의 어머니는 신실하지 않았다. \q 그 여자는 부끄러운 짓을 했다. \q 그 여자는 말했다. "나는 내 애인들을 따라가겠다. 그들이 나에게 먹을 것과 마실 물, \q 양털과 베, \q 올리브기름과 마실 것을 준다."

vi.L: Vì mẹ chúng đã làm điếm; \q kẻ đã thụ thai chúng đã hành động cách đáng hổ thẹn. \q Vì nàng nói: "Tôi sẽ đi theo các tình nhân của tôi, những kẻ ban bánh và nước của tôi, \q len và vải gai của tôi, \q dầu và thức uống của tôi."
vi.B: Mẹ chúng đã làm điếm; \q người đã cưu mang chúng đã cư xử cách nhơ nhuốc. \q Vì nàng nói: "Tôi sẽ đi theo các tình nhân của tôi, là những người cho tôi lương thực và nước uống, \q len và vải gai, \q dầu và thức uống."
vi.R: Mẹ chúng đã không chung thủy. \q Nàng đã làm những điều đáng xấu hổ. \q Nàng nói: "Tôi sẽ chạy theo các tình nhân của tôi. Họ cho tôi thức ăn và nước uống, \q len và vải lanh, \q dầu ô-liu và đồ uống."

sw.L: Kwa maana mama yao amefanya ukahaba; \q yeye aliyewachukua mimba ametenda kwa aibu. \q Kwa maana alisema, "Nitawafuata wapenzi wangu, wanaonipa mkate wangu na maji yangu, \q sufu yangu na kitani yangu, \q mafuta yangu na vinywaji vyangu."
sw.B: Mama yao amefanya ukahaba; \q yeye aliyewachukua mimba ameenenda kwa aibu. \q Kwa maana alisema, "Nitawafuata wapenzi wangu, wanaonipa chakula changu na maji yangu, \q sufu yangu na kitani yangu, \q mafuta yangu na kinywaji changu."
sw.R: Mama yao hakuwa mwaminifu. \q Amefanya mambo ya aibu. \q Alisema, "Nitawafuata wapenzi wangu. Wao ndio wanaonipa chakula changu na maji yangu, \q sufu yangu na kitani yangu, \q mafuta yangu ya zeituni na vinywaji vyangu."

decisions.choice: my lovers: the Baals, the gods she thinks give her food and clothing
decisions.reason: The lovers are named in 2:15 and 2:19 as the Baals, the local forms of the Canaanite storm god, who was worshiped as the giver of rain and crops. Hosea also uses the language of lovers for Israel's turning to foreign powers for help (8:9). Here the gifts she names, food, water, wool, flax, oil and drink, are the gifts of the land, and 2:10 answers that it was the LORD who gave them.

decisions.choice: acted shamefully: behaved in a way that brings disgrace
decisions.reason: The verb comes from the word for shame. It means more than feeling ashamed: she has done what disgraces her and her children.

decisions.choice: my bread ... my drinks: she calls the gifts her own
decisions.reason: Six times she says "my". In 2:11 the LORD answers with "my grain ... my new wine ... my wool and my flax": the gifts were his, given to her.

decisions.choice: food (B, R); linen (R); olive oil (R)
decisions.reason: "Bread" means food in general here, and Balanced and Readable say "food". Balanced says "my" once for each pair, as English does; Literal repeats it as the Hebrew does. Flax is the plant linen is made from, and the oil is olive oil; Readable uses the words a reader knows.

decisions.choice: the wife says "tôi"
decisions.reason: When the woman who stands for Israel speaks, she says "tôi", as Zion does in the terms note; it is neither proud nor humble.

decisions.choice: "애인들" for the lovers
decisions.reason: Plain modern Korean for the woman's lovers, which the shared decision identifies as the Baals; it is used throughout the chapter.

source.text: לָכֵ֛ן הִנְנִי־שָׂ֥ךְ אֶת־דַּרְכֵּ֖ךְ בַּסִּירִ֑ים וְגָֽדַרְתִּי֙ אֶת־גְּדֵרָ֔הּ וּנְתִיבוֹתֶ֖יהָ לֹ֥א תִמְצָֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore here I [am] hedging up your way with thorns, and I will wall up her wall, and her paths not she will find.

en.L: Therefore, look, I am hedging up your way with thorns, \q and I will build up her wall, \q and she will not find her paths.
en.B: Therefore I will block your way with thorns, \q and I will wall her in, \q so that she cannot find her paths.
en.R: So I will block her road with thorn bushes. \q I will build a wall around her, \q so that she cannot find her way.

es.L: Por tanto, he aquí, yo cerco tu camino con espinos, \q y levantaré un muro contra ella, \q y no hallará sus senderos.
es.B: Por eso te cerraré el camino con espinos, \q y la encerraré con un muro, \q para que no encuentre sus senderos.
es.R: Por eso le cerraré el camino con zarzas. \q Construiré un muro a su alrededor, \q para que no encuentre por dónde ir.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi, voici, je vais barrer ton chemin avec des épines, \q et j’élèverai son mur, \q et elle ne trouvera pas ses sentiers.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi je fermerai ton chemin avec des épines \q et je l’entourerai d’un mur, \q pour qu’elle ne trouve plus ses sentiers.
fr.R: Alors je bloquerai sa route avec des buissons d’épines. \q Je construirai un mur autour d’elle, \q pour qu’elle ne puisse plus trouver son chemin.

ko.L: 그러므로 보라, 내가 가시나무로 네 길을 막고, \q 그 여자 앞에 담을 쌓겠다. \q 그러면 그 여자가 자기 길을 찾지 못할 것이다.
ko.B: 그러므로 내가 가시나무로 네 길을 막고 \q 담을 쌓아 그 여자를 가두겠다. \q 그 여자는 자기 길을 찾지 못할 것이다.
ko.R: 그래서 나는 가시덤불로 그 여자의 길을 막겠다. \q 그 여자 둘레에 담을 쌓겠다. \q 그러면 그 여자는 갈 길을 찾지 못할 것이다.

vi.L: Vì vậy, này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lấy gai rào đường ngươi lại, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ xây tường chắn nàng, \q và nàng sẽ không tìm được các lối đi của mình.
vi.B: Vì vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lấy gai góc chặn đường ngươi, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ xây tường vây nàng lại, \q để nàng không tìm được lối đi của mình.
vi.R: Vì vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lấy bụi gai chặn đường nàng. \q Ta sẽ xây tường bao quanh nàng, \q để nàng không tìm được lối đi.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo, tazama, ninaiziba njia yako kwa miiba, \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitamjengea ukuta, \q naye hatavipata vijia vyake.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo nitaizuia njia yako kwa miiba, \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitamzungushia ukuta, \q asiweze kuvipata vijia vyake.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nitaifunga barabara yake kwa vichaka vya miiba. \q Nitajenga ukuta kumzunguka, \q ili asiweze kuipata njia yake.

decisions.choice: your way: the LORD turns for a moment to speak to the woman herself
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "your way" (addressed to a woman) and then goes on with "her wall" and "her paths". Such changes of person are common in the prophets. The Greek translation has "her way", making the verse consistent; the Hebrew is followed here.

decisions.choice: hedge your way with thorns, wall her in: stop her from reaching her lovers
decisions.reason: Thorn hedges and stone walls kept animals in fields and travelers on the road. To block a way is to make it impossible to go on (Job 19:8; Lamentations 3:7, 9). The LORD will stop her from reaching her lovers, and so bring her to turn back (2:9).

decisions.choice: her road
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the woman in the third person through the verse, so that the reader does not think someone else is meant by "your" (m1). The person spoken about is the same; only the sudden turn to address her is not reproduced.

decisions.choice: "tu camino" (L), "te cerraré" (B), then "ella"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns for a moment to the woman herself ("your way") and back to "her"; Literal and Balanced keep the turn with tú, Readable says "her" throughout, as the English Readable does.

source.text: וְרִדְּפָ֤ה אֶת־מְאַהֲבֶ֨יהָ֙ וְלֹֽא־תַשִּׂ֣יג אֹתָ֔ם וּבִקְשָׁ֖תַם וְלֹ֣א תִמְצָ֑א וְאָמְרָ֗ה אֵלְכָ֤ה וְאָשׁ֨וּבָה֙ אֶל־אִישִׁ֣י הָֽרִאשׁ֔וֹן כִּ֣י ט֥וֹב לִ֛י אָ֖ז מֵעָֽתָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And she will pursue her lovers and not she will overtake them, and she will seek them and not she will find; and she will say, I will go and I will return to my husband the first, for [it was] good for me then more than now.

en.L: And she will pursue her lovers, but she will not overtake them; \q and she will seek them, but she will not find [them]. \q And she will say, "Let me go and return to my husband, the first, \q for [it was] better for me then than now."
en.B: She will chase after her lovers but not catch them; \q she will look for them but not find them. \q Then she will say, "I will go back to my first husband, \q for I was better off then than now."
en.R: She will run after her lovers, but she will not catch them. \q She will look for them, but she will not find them. \q Then she will say, "I will go back to my first husband. \q I was better off then than I am now."

es.L: Y perseguirá a sus amantes, pero no los alcanzará; \q y los buscará, pero no [los] hallará. \q Y dirá: «Iré y volveré a mi primer marido, \q porque mejor me [iba] entonces que ahora».
es.B: Correrá tras sus amantes, pero no los alcanzará; \q los buscará, pero no los encontrará. \q Entonces dirá: «Volveré a mi primer marido, \q porque entonces me iba mejor que ahora».
es.R: Correrá detrás de sus amantes, pero no los alcanzará. \q Los buscará, pero no los encontrará. \q Entonces dirá: «Volveré a mi primer marido. \q Entonces me iba mejor que ahora».

fr.L: Et elle poursuivra ses amants, mais elle ne les atteindra pas ; \q et elle les cherchera, mais elle ne [les] trouvera pas. \q Et elle dira : « Je veux aller et revenir à mon mari, le premier, \q car [c’était] mieux pour moi alors que maintenant. »
fr.B: Elle courra après ses amants sans les rattraper ; \q elle les cherchera sans les trouver. \q Alors elle dira : « Je vais revenir à mon premier mari, \q car j’étais mieux alors que maintenant. »
fr.R: Elle courra après ses amants, mais elle ne les rattrapera pas. \q Elle les cherchera, mais elle ne les trouvera pas. \q Alors elle dira : « Je vais revenir à mon premier mari. \q J’étais plus heureuse avant que maintenant. »

ko.L: 그 여자가 자기 애인들을 뒤쫓아도 따라잡지 못하고, \q 그들을 찾아도 [그들을] 만나지 못할 것이다. \q 그때에 그 여자가 말할 것이다. "내가 가서 내 남편, 처음 [남편에게] 돌아가야겠다. \q 그때가 지금보다 나에게 더 좋았다."
ko.B: 그 여자는 애인들을 뒤쫓아 다녀도 따라잡지 못하고, \q 그들을 찾아다녀도 만나지 못할 것이다. \q 그제야 그 여자는 말할 것이다. "내 첫 남편에게 돌아가야겠다. \q 그때가 지금보다 훨씬 나았다."
ko.R: 그 여자는 애인들을 쫓아다니겠지만 따라잡지 못할 것이다. \q 그들을 찾아다니겠지만 만나지 못할 것이다. \q 그제야 그 여자는 말할 것이다. "내 첫 남편에게 돌아가야겠다. \q 그때가 지금보다 살기가 더 좋았다."

vi.L: Và nàng sẽ đuổi theo các tình nhân mình, nhưng sẽ không đuổi kịp họ; \q và nàng sẽ tìm kiếm họ, nhưng sẽ không tìm thấy [họ]. \q Rồi nàng sẽ nói: "Tôi sẽ đi và trở về với chồng tôi, người đầu tiên, \q vì khi ấy [thật] tốt cho tôi hơn bây giờ."
vi.B: Nàng sẽ đuổi theo các tình nhân mình mà không bắt kịp; \q nàng sẽ tìm họ mà không gặp. \q Bấy giờ nàng sẽ nói: "Tôi sẽ trở về với người chồng đầu tiên của tôi, \q vì khi ấy tôi sung sướng hơn bây giờ."
vi.R: Nàng sẽ chạy theo các tình nhân mình, nhưng không bắt kịp họ. \q Nàng sẽ tìm họ, nhưng không gặp được. \q Bấy giờ nàng sẽ nói: "Tôi sẽ trở về với người chồng đầu tiên của tôi. \q Hồi ấy tôi sống sung sướng hơn bây giờ nhiều."

sw.L: Naye atawafuatia wapenzi wake, lakini hatawapata; \q naye atawatafuta, lakini hatawaona. \q Naye atasema, "Nitakwenda nirudi kwa mume wangu, yule wa kwanza, \q kwa maana [ilikuwa] heri kwangu wakati ule kuliko sasa."
sw.B: Atawakimbilia wapenzi wake lakini hatawafikia; \q atawatafuta lakini hatawaona. \q Ndipo atasema, "Nitarudi kwa mume wangu wa kwanza, \q kwa maana hali yangu ilikuwa bora wakati ule kuliko sasa."
sw.R: Atawakimbilia wapenzi wake, lakini hatawafikia. \q Atawatafuta, lakini hatawaona. \q Ndipo atasema, "Nitarudi kwa mume wangu wa kwanza. \q Maisha yangu yalikuwa mazuri zaidi wakati ule kuliko sasa."

decisions.choice: my first husband: the LORD, who took Israel as his own when he brought them out of Egypt
decisions.reason: The first husband is the LORD (2:4, 17-18). The law did not allow a woman to go back to her first husband once she had belonged to another man (Deuteronomy 24:1-4), and Jeremiah 3:1 asks whether Israel can return. Here the LORD himself is preparing the way back.

decisions.choice: for it was better for me then than now: a return driven by need
decisions.reason: Her reason is her own comfort: life was better with her husband. It is a first step, not yet the love of 2:16-22. The LORD uses her need to bring her back.

decisions.choice: pursue ... seek: she chases her lovers eagerly
decisions.reason: "Pursue" is a strong verb, used for hunting or chasing an enemy. "Seek" is the verb used for seeking God (3:5; 5:15). She puts into her lovers the effort that belongs to seeking the LORD.

decisions.choice: "revenir" for shuv at every level, throughout Hosea
decisions.reason: As the term sheet carries over from Jeremiah: one verb for returning to a husband, to God and from exile keeps Hosea's play on the word (3:5; 6:1; 11:5; 14:2).

source.text: וְהִיא֙ לֹ֣א יָֽדְעָ֔ה כִּ֤י אָֽנֹכִי֙ נָתַ֣תִּי לָ֔הּ הַדָּגָ֖ן וְהַתִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְהַיִּצְהָ֑ר וְכֶ֨סֶף הִרְבֵּ֥יתִי לָ֛הּ וְזָהָ֖ב עָשׂ֥וּ לַבָּֽעַל׃

records.literal_gloss: And she not knew that I gave to her the grain and the new wine and the fresh oil, and silver I multiplied for her, and gold [which] they made for Baal.

en.L: And she did not know \q that I {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} gave her the grain and the new wine and the fresh oil, \q and multiplied for her silver, and gold [that] they made for Baal.
en.B: She did not acknowledge \q that it was I who gave her the grain, the new wine, and the olive oil, \q and who lavished on her the silver and gold that they used for Baal.
en.R: She did not understand \q that I was the one who gave her the grain, the wine, and the olive oil. \q I gave her more and more silver and gold, but they used it for Baal.

es.L: Y ella no reconoció \q que yo mismo le di el grano, el mosto y el aceite fresco, \q y le multipliqué la plata, y el oro [que] usaron para Baal.
es.B: Ella no quiso reconocer \q que era yo quien le daba el grano, el vino nuevo y el aceite de oliva, \q y quien la colmó de la plata y el oro que usaron para Baal.
es.R: Ella no entendió \q que yo era quien le daba el grano, el vino y el aceite de oliva. \q Le di más y más plata y oro, pero ellos lo usaron para Baal.

fr.L: Et elle n’a pas su \q que c’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui lui ai donné le blé et le vin nouveau et l’huile fraîche, \q et [qui] ai multiplié pour elle l’argent, et l’or [qu’]ils ont fait pour Baal.
fr.B: Elle n’a pas reconnu \q que c’était {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui lui donnais le blé, le vin nouveau et l’huile, \q et qui la comblais d’argent et d’or, dont ils se sont servis pour Baal.
fr.R: Elle n’a pas compris \q que c’était {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui lui donnais le blé, le vin et l’huile d’olive. \q Je lui ai donné de plus en plus d’argent et d’or, mais ils s’en sont servis pour Baal.

ko.L: 그 여자는 알지 못했다. \q 그 여자에게 곡식과 새 포도주와 햇기름을 준 것이 바로 나였고, \q 그 여자에게 은을 많게 하고 금도 [많게 했는데], 그들이 그것으로 바알을 만들었다는 것을.
ko.B: 그 여자는 깨닫지 못했다. \q 그 여자에게 곡식과 새 포도주와 기름을 준 이가 바로 나였고, \q 그들이 바알을 위해 쓴 은과 금을 넘치도록 준 이도 나였다는 것을.
ko.R: 그 여자는 알지 못했다. \q 곡식과 포도주와 올리브기름을 준 것이 바로 나였다는 것을. \q 나는 그 여자에게 은과 금을 점점 더 많이 주었는데, 그들은 그것을 바알을 위해 썼다.

vi.L: Và nàng đã không biết \q rằng chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ban cho nàng ngũ cốc, rượu mới và dầu mới, \q và đã gia tăng cho nàng bạc, và vàng [mà] chúng đã làm cho Ba-anh.
vi.B: Nàng không nhìn nhận \q rằng chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ban cho nàng ngũ cốc, rượu mới và dầu ô-liu, \q và đã ban dư dật cho nàng bạc và vàng mà chúng đã dùng cho Ba-anh.
vi.R: Nàng không hiểu \q rằng chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Đấng đã ban cho nàng ngũ cốc, rượu và dầu ô-liu. \q Ta đã ban cho nàng bạc vàng ngày càng nhiều, nhưng chúng lại dùng bạc vàng ấy cho Ba-anh.

sw.L: Naye hakujua \q kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndiye niliyempa nafaka na divai mpya na mafuta mapya, \q na kumwongezea fedha, na dhahabu waliyoifanyia Baali.
sw.B: Hakutambua \q kwamba ni {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} niliyempa nafaka, divai mpya na mafuta, \q na niliyemmiminia fedha na dhahabu waliyoitumia kwa ajili ya Baali.
sw.R: Hakuelewa \q kwamba ni {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} niliyempa nafaka, divai na mafuta ya zeituni. \q Nilimpa fedha na dhahabu zaidi na zaidi, lakini waliitumia kwa ajili ya Baali.

decisions.choice: she did not know: she did not acknowledge the giver
decisions.reason: In Hosea "know" often means to recognize and honor someone in a relationship, not just to have information (4:1, 6; 6:6). She knew where her food came from in fact, but did not acknowledge that it came from the LORD. The promise of 2:22 answers this: "you will know the LORD".

decisions.choice: the grain, the new wine and the fresh oil: the three chief harvests of the land
decisions.reason: These three stand for all the produce of the land and are named together in the covenant blessings (Deuteronomy 7:13; 11:14). The new wine is the juice of the grape harvest, the fresh oil the olive harvest.

decisions.choice: gold they made for Baal: used for Baal, or made into images of Baal
decisions.reason: The words are short: "gold they made for Baal". They may mean that the people offered silver and gold in Baal's worship, or that they made it into images, as 8:4 and 13:2 say they made idols of their silver and gold. "They" is the people whom the woman stands for.

decisions.choice: acknowledge (B); understand (R); lavished (B); more and more (R); used (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced says "acknowledge" for the sense of "know" here (m1); Readable says "understand". "Multiplied" is "lavished" at Balanced and "more and more" at Readable. Balanced and Readable say "used for Baal", which covers both readings of m3.

decisions.choice: "el grano, el mosto y el aceite fresco" (L); "el grano, el vino nuevo y el aceite de oliva" (B); "el grano, el vino y el aceite de oliva" (R)
decisions.reason: The three harvests in the words of the Spanish Deuteronomy 11:14 at each level, kept through Hosea and Joel.

decisions.choice: "no reconoció"
decisions.reason: "Know" here means acknowledging the giver; even Literal says "reconocer", since "no supo" would mean she lacked the information.

decisions.choice: "c'est moi qui" with a deity_pronoun span on the stressed "moi" at every level
alternatives: no span where the English Balanced and Readable have none
decisions.reason: French marks the Hebrew's emphatic "I" with a stressed pronoun, which takes the span as God's other pronouns do; "je" never does.

decisions.choice: "ngũ cốc, rượu mới và dầu mới" (L); "... dầu ô-liu" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The three harvests in the published wording (Deuteronomy 11:14; 2 Chronicles 31:5); Literal keeps "fresh" for yitshar. Used again in 2:24.

decisions.choice: "곡식과 새 포도주와 햇기름" (L); "곡식과 새 포도주와 기름" (B); "곡식과 포도주와 올리브기름" (R)
decisions.reason: The three chief harvests, worded the same way wherever Hosea and Joel name them.

decisions.choice: "Baali"; the Baals "Mabaali" (2:15, 19)
decisions.reason: The forms the published Swahili uses in Judges and Kings.

decisions.choice: "dhahabu waliyoifanyia Baali" (gold they made for Baal)
decisions.reason: Keeps the Hebrew open: used for Baal or made into images of Baal (m3). Balanced and Readable say "waliyoitumia" (used), as the English does.

source.text: לָכֵ֣ן אָשׁ֔וּב וְלָקַחְתִּ֤י דְגָנִי֙ בְּעִתּ֔וֹ וְתִירוֹשִׁ֖י בְּמֽוֹעֲד֑וֹ וְהִצַּלְתִּי֙ צַמְרִ֣י וּפִשְׁתִּ֔י לְכַסּ֖וֹת אֶת־עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore I will return and I will take my grain in its time and my new wine in its season, and I will snatch away my wool and my flax, to cover her nakedness.

en.L: Therefore I will turn back and take my grain in its time \q and my new wine in its appointed time, \q and I will snatch away my wool and my flax, \q [given] to cover her nakedness.
en.B: So I will take back my grain at harvest time \q and my new wine in its season. \q I will snatch away my wool and my flax, \q which were to cover her nakedness.
en.R: So I will take back my grain and my wine \q when it is time to harvest them. \q I will take away my wool and my linen \q that I gave her to cover her naked body.

es.L: Por tanto, volveré y tomaré mi grano a su tiempo \q y mi mosto en su sazón, \q y arrebataré mi lana y mi lino, \q [dados] para cubrir su desnudez.
es.B: Por eso recuperaré mi grano en el tiempo de la cosecha \q y mi vino nuevo en su temporada. \q Le arrebataré mi lana y mi lino, \q que eran para cubrir su desnudez.
es.R: Por eso recuperaré mi grano y mi vino \q cuando sea el tiempo de cosecharlos. \q Le quitaré mi lana y mi lino, \q que le di para cubrir su cuerpo desnudo.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi je reviendrai et je prendrai mon blé en son temps \q et mon vin nouveau en sa saison, \q et j’arracherai ma laine et mon lin, \q [donnés] pour couvrir sa nudité.
fr.B: Alors je reprendrai mon blé au temps de la moisson \q et mon vin nouveau en sa saison. \q J’arracherai ma laine et mon lin, \q qui devaient couvrir sa nudité.
fr.R: Alors je reprendrai mon blé et mon vin \q au moment de la récolte. \q J’enlèverai ma laine et mon lin, \q que je lui avais donnés pour couvrir son corps nu.

ko.L: 그러므로 내가 돌이켜, 제철에 내 곡식을, \q 제때에 내 새 포도주를 거두어 가겠다. \q 그리고 내 양털과 내 삼을 빼앗겠다. \q [그것들은] 그 여자의 알몸을 가리라고 [준 것이다].
ko.B: 그러므로 나는 거둘 때가 되면 내 곡식을 되찾고 \q 제철이 되면 내 새 포도주를 되찾겠다. \q 내 양털과 내 삼도 빼앗겠다. \q 그것들은 그 여자의 알몸을 가리라고 준 것이었다.
ko.R: 그래서 나는 거둘 때가 되면 \q 내 곡식과 내 포도주를 도로 가져가겠다. \q 내 양털과 내 베도 빼앗겠다. \q 그것들은 그 여자의 벗은 몸을 가리라고 내가 준 것이었다.

vi.L: Vì vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ quay lại và lấy ngũ cốc của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vào thời của nó \q và rượu mới của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vào kỳ đã định của nó, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giật lấy len và vải gai của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q [là những thứ ban ra] để che sự trần truồng của nàng.
vi.B: Vì vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lấy lại ngũ cốc của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vào mùa gặt \q và rượu mới của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vào mùa của nó. \q Ta sẽ giật lại len và vải gai của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q là những thứ dùng để che thân thể trần truồng của nàng.
vi.R: Vì vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lấy lại ngũ cốc và rượu của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} \q khi đến mùa thu hoạch. \q Ta sẽ lấy đi len và vải lanh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q là những thứ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã cho nàng để che thân.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo nitarudi, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitachukua nafaka yangu wakati wake \q na divai yangu mpya katika majira yake, \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitanyakua sufu yangu na kitani yangu, \q [zilizotolewa] kufunika uchi wake.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo nitaichukua tena nafaka yangu wakati wa mavuno \q na divai yangu mpya katika majira yake. \q Nitanyakua sufu yangu na kitani yangu, \q vilivyokuwa vya kufunika uchi wake.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nitachukua tena nafaka yangu na divai yangu \q wakati utakapofika wa kuvuna. \q Nitaondoa sufu yangu na kitani yangu \q nilivyompa ili kufunika mwili wake ulio uchi.

decisions.choice: I will return and take: I will take back
decisions.reason: "Return" before another verb often means doing it again or doing it in reverse. Here it means taking back what was given.

decisions.choice: my grain, my new wine, my wool, my flax: the LORD claims the gifts she called hers
decisions.reason: The words answer her claim in 2:7, "my bread ... my wool and my flax". The gifts belonged to the LORD, who gave them.

decisions.choice: in its time, in its season: at harvest, just when she expects it
decisions.reason: The harvest will fail at the very time it should come in. The words show that the LORD rules the seasons, which the people credited to Baal.

decisions.choice: linen (R); her naked body (R); that I gave her (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says "linen" for flax, as in 2:7, and makes plain that the LORD had given the wool and flax to clothe her.

decisions.choice: "nafaka yangu", "sufu yangu" without deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Here the English has no span on "my" either; in this chapter Swahili follows the English and puts spans only where the English has them, and only on free pronouns.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֛ה אֲגַלֶּ֥ה אֶת־נַבְלֻתָ֖הּ לְעֵינֵ֣י מְאַהֲבֶ֑יהָ וְאִ֖ישׁ לֹֽא־יַצִּילֶ֥נָּה מִיָּדִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And now I will uncover her shamelessness to [the] eyes of her lovers, and anyone not will deliver her from my hand.

en.L: And now I will uncover her shamelessness before the eyes of her lovers, \q and no one will deliver her from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand.
en.B: Now I will lay bare her lewdness before her lovers' eyes, \q and no one will rescue her from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand.
en.R: Now I will show her shame to her lovers, \q and no one will be able to rescue her from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: Y ahora descubriré su impudicia a los ojos de sus amantes, \q y nadie la librará de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano.
es.B: Ahora pondré al descubierto su indecencia ante los ojos de sus amantes, \q y nadie la rescatará de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano.
es.R: Ahora mostraré su vergüenza a sus amantes, \q y nadie podrá rescatarla de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.

fr.L: Et maintenant je découvrirai son impudeur aux yeux de ses amants, \q et personne ne la délivrera de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main.
fr.B: Maintenant je mettrai à nu sa honte sous les yeux de ses amants, \q et personne ne l’arrachera de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main.
fr.R: Maintenant je montrerai sa honte à ses amants, \q et personne ne pourra la sauver de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.

ko.L: 이제 내가 그 여자의 애인들의 눈앞에서 그 여자의 수치를 드러내겠다. \q 아무도 그 여자를 내 손에서 건져 내지 못할 것이다.
ko.B: 이제 내가 그 여자의 애인들이 보는 앞에서 그 여자의 음란함을 드러내겠다. \q 아무도 그 여자를 내 손에서 구해 내지 못할 것이다.
ko.R: 이제 나는 그 여자의 애인들에게 그 여자의 부끄러운 모습을 보이겠다. \q 아무도 그 여자를 나에게서 구해 낼 수 없을 것이다.

vi.L: Và bây giờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phơi bày sự nhơ nhuốc của nàng trước mắt các tình nhân của nàng, \q và không ai sẽ giải cứu nàng khỏi tay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Bây giờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phơi bày sự dâm đãng của nàng trước mắt các tình nhân nàng, \q và không ai giải cứu được nàng khỏi tay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Bây giờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phơi bày sự xấu hổ của nàng trước mặt các tình nhân nàng, \q và không ai có thể giải cứu nàng khỏi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

sw.L: Na sasa nitaufunua ufisadi wake mbele ya macho ya wapenzi wake, \q wala hakuna mtu atakayemwokoa mkononi {{deity_pronoun:mwangu|Mwangu}}.
sw.B: Sasa nitaianika aibu yake mbele ya macho ya wapenzi wake, \q wala hakuna atakayemwokoa mkononi {{deity_pronoun:mwangu|Mwangu}}.
sw.R: Sasa nitaionyesha aibu yake kwa wapenzi wake, \q wala hakuna atakayeweza kumwokoa kutoka {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}.

decisions.choice: her shamelessness: her shameful, exposed body; the exact sense is uncertain
decisions.reason: The noun is found only here. It is related to a word for a foolish or worthless person and perhaps to a word for something withered. It seems to mean her shame, her body stripped bare (as 2:5), or her lewd conduct. The overall sense is clear: her disgrace will be laid open before the lovers she trusted.

decisions.choice: no one will deliver her from my hand: her lovers cannot protect her
decisions.reason: The lovers will watch and do nothing (2:9). Being "in the hand" of someone means being in his power.

source.text: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי֙ כָּל־מְשׂוֹשָׂ֔הּ חַגָּ֖הּ חָדְשָׁ֣הּ וְשַׁבַּתָּ֑הּ וְכֹ֖ל מוֹעֲדָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will put an end to all her joy, her festival, her new moon and her sabbath, and every appointed feast of hers.

en.L: And I will put an end to all her joy, \q her festival, her new moon, and her Sabbath, \q and all her appointed feasts.
en.B: I will put an end to all her celebrations, \q her festivals, her new moons, and her Sabbaths, \q and all her appointed feasts.
en.R: I will put a stop to all her celebrations: \q her yearly festivals, her new moon feasts, her Sabbath days, \q and all her other holy days.

es.L: Y haré cesar toda su alegría, \q su fiesta, su luna nueva y su sábado, \q y todas sus fiestas señaladas.
es.B: Pondré fin a todas sus celebraciones, \q sus fiestas, sus lunas nuevas y sus sábados, \q y todas sus fiestas solemnes.
es.R: Acabaré con todas sus celebraciones: \q sus fiestas de cada año, sus fiestas de luna nueva, sus días de sábado \q y todos sus otros días santos.

fr.L: Et je ferai cesser toute sa joie, \q sa fête, sa nouvelle lune et son sabbat, \q et toutes ses solennités.
fr.B: Je mettrai fin à toutes ses réjouissances, \q à ses fêtes, à ses nouvelles lunes et à ses sabbats, \q et à toutes ses solennités.
fr.R: Je ferai cesser toutes ses célébrations : \q ses fêtes annuelles, ses fêtes de la nouvelle lune, ses jours de sabbat \q et tous ses autres jours saints.

ko.L: 내가 그 여자의 모든 기쁨, \q 그 여자의 절기와 초하루와 안식일과 \q 모든 정한 절기를 그치게 하겠다.
ko.B: 내가 그 여자의 모든 즐거움, \q 곧 절기와 초하루와 안식일과 \q 모든 정한 절기를 끝내겠다.
ko.R: 나는 그 여자의 모든 잔치를 그치게 하겠다. \q 해마다 지키는 절기와 초하루 축제와 안식일과 \q 그 밖의 모든 거룩한 날을 그치게 하겠다.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ chấm dứt mọi niềm vui của nàng, \q kỳ lễ của nàng, ngày trăng mới của nàng, và ngày Sa-bát của nàng, \q cùng mọi kỳ lễ đã định của nàng.
vi.B: Ta sẽ chấm dứt mọi cuộc vui của nàng, \q các kỳ lễ, các ngày trăng mới và các ngày Sa-bát của nàng, \q cùng mọi kỳ lễ đã định của nàng.
vi.R: Ta sẽ dẹp bỏ mọi cuộc vui của nàng: \q các lễ hằng năm, các lễ trăng mới, các ngày Sa-bát, \q và mọi ngày lễ thánh khác của nàng.

sw.L: Nami nitaikomesha furaha yake yote, \q sikukuu yake, mwandamo wa mwezi wake, na Sabato yake, \q na sikukuu zake zote zilizoamriwa.
sw.B: Nitazikomesha sherehe zake zote, \q sikukuu zake, sikukuu za mwandamo wa mwezi, na Sabato zake, \q na sikukuu zake zote zilizoamriwa.
sw.R: Nitazikomesha sherehe zake zote: \q sikukuu zake za kila mwaka, sikukuu za mwezi mpya, siku zake za Sabato, \q na siku zake nyingine zote takatifu.

decisions.choice: festival, new moon, Sabbath, appointed feast: Israel's yearly, monthly and weekly holy days
decisions.reason: The festivals were the three pilgrimage feasts of the year (Exodus 23:14-17). The new moon began each month with offerings (Numbers 28:11). The Sabbath was the weekly day of rest. "Appointed feasts" covers all the holy days the law set (Leviticus 23). Isaiah 1:13-14 lists the same days.

decisions.choice: her festivals: the feasts have become hers, not the LORD's
decisions.reason: The law calls them "the appointed feasts of the LORD" (Leviticus 23:2). Here every one is "hers": they have become occasions of her own pleasure, mixed with the worship of the Baals (2:15).

decisions.choice: celebrations (B, R); yearly festivals, new moon feasts, Sabbath days, other holy days (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses singular nouns for each kind of feast; Balanced and Readable use plurals, since all of them are meant. Readable says what each kind of day is (m1).

decisions.choice: "su luna nueva", "su sábado"
decisions.reason: As the published Spanish of Samuel and Chronicles: "luna nueva", and "sábado" for the Sabbath, as in the Spanish New Testament.

decisions.choice: "절기, 초하루, 안식일, 정한 절기"
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch's words for Israel's feasts; "초하루" is the plain word for the new-moon day.

source.text: וַהֲשִׁמֹּתִ֗י גַּפְנָהּ֙ וּתְאֵ֣נָתָ֔הּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמְרָ֗ה אֶתְנָ֥ה הֵ֨מָּה֙ לִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתְנוּ־לִ֖י מְאַֽהֲבָ֑י וְשַׂמְתִּ֣ים לְיַ֔עַר וַאֲכָלָ֖תַם חַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will lay waste her vine and her fig tree, of which she said, Wages [are] they for me, which gave to me my lovers; and I will make them into a thicket, and will eat them [the] animal of the field.

en.L: And I will lay waste her vine and her fig tree, \q of which she said, "They [are] my wages, which my lovers have given me"; \q and I will make them a thicket, \q and the beasts of the field will eat them.
en.B: I will lay waste her vines and her fig trees, \q of which she said, "These are my pay, which my lovers gave me." \q I will turn them into a thicket, \q and the wild animals will eat them up.
en.R: I will destroy her grapevines and her fig trees. \q She said, "These are what my lovers paid me." \q I will turn them into a thicket, \q and wild animals will eat them.

es.L: Y devastaré su vid y su higuera, \q de las cuales dijo: «Son mi paga, la que me dieron mis amantes»; \q y las convertiré en un matorral, \q y las comerán las bestias del campo.
es.B: Destruiré sus vides y sus higueras, \q de las que dijo: «Son mi pago, el que me dieron mis amantes». \q Las convertiré en un matorral, \q y se las comerán los animales salvajes.
es.R: Destruiré sus viñas y sus higueras. \q Ella dijo: «Esto es lo que me pagaron mis amantes». \q Las convertiré en un matorral, \q y los animales salvajes se las comerán.

fr.L: Et je dévasterai sa vigne et son figuier, \q dont elle a dit : « Ils [sont] mon salaire, que m’ont donné mes amants » ; \q et j’en ferai un fourré, \q et les bêtes des champs les mangeront.
fr.B: Je ravagerai ses vignes et ses figuiers, \q dont elle disait : « C’est mon salaire, que mes amants m’ont donné. » \q J’en ferai une broussaille, \q et les bêtes sauvages les dévoreront.
fr.R: Je détruirai ses vignes et ses figuiers. \q Elle disait : « C’est ce que mes amants m’ont payé. » \q J’en ferai une broussaille, \q et les animaux sauvages les mangeront.

ko.L: 내가 그 여자의 포도나무와 무화과나무를 황폐하게 하겠다. \q 그 여자는 그것들을 두고 "이것들은 내 애인들이 나에게 준 내 몸값이다" 하고 말했다. \q 내가 그것들을 덤불로 만들 것이니, \q 들짐승들이 그것들을 먹을 것이다.
ko.B: 나는 그 여자의 포도나무와 무화과나무를 망쳐 놓겠다. \q 그 여자는 "이것은 내 애인들이 준 화대다" 하고 말했다. \q 나는 그것들을 덤불로 만들겠다. \q 들짐승들이 그것을 먹어 치울 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 그 여자의 포도나무와 무화과나무를 망쳐 놓겠다. \q 그 여자는 "이것은 내 애인들이 나에게 값으로 준 것이다" 하고 말했다. \q 나는 그 밭을 덤불로 만들겠다. \q 들짐승들이 그것을 먹어 버릴 것이다.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ tàn phá cây nho và cây vả của nàng, \q về chúng nàng đã nói: "Chúng [là] tiền công của tôi, mà các tình nhân của tôi đã cho tôi"; \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ biến chúng thành bụi rậm, \q và thú đồng sẽ ăn chúng.
vi.B: Ta sẽ tàn phá vườn nho và cây vả của nàng, \q là những thứ nàng từng nói: "Đây là tiền công các tình nhân đã trả cho tôi." \q Ta sẽ biến chúng thành bụi rậm, \q và thú hoang sẽ ăn nuốt chúng.
vi.R: Ta sẽ phá hủy cây nho và cây vả của nàng. \q Nàng đã nói: "Đây là thứ các tình nhân trả công cho tôi." \q Ta sẽ biến chúng thành bụi rậm, \q và thú hoang sẽ ăn chúng.

sw.L: Nami nitaharibu mzabibu wake na mtini wake, \q ambavyo alisema, "Hivi [ni] ujira wangu, ambao wapenzi wangu wamenipa"; \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitavifanya kuwa kichaka, \q na wanyama wa mwituni watavila.
sw.B: Nitaiharibu mizabibu yake na mitini yake, \q ambayo alisema, "Huu ni ujira wangu, walionipa wapenzi wangu." \q Nitaigeuza kuwa kichaka, \q na wanyama wa porini wataila.
sw.R: Nitaiharibu mizabibu yake na mitini yake. \q Alisema, "Haya ndiyo malipo ambayo wapenzi wangu walinipa." \q Nitaigeuza kuwa kichaka, \q na wanyama wa porini wataila.

decisions.choice: wages: a prostitute's pay
decisions.reason: The word is used for the fee paid to a prostitute (compare 9:1; Deuteronomy 23:19; Micah 1:7). It sounds like the word for "fig tree" in the same verse: the fig trees she counts as her fee will be destroyed.

decisions.choice: vine and fig tree: a picture of peace and plenty
decisions.reason: To sit under one's own vine and fig tree was the picture of a settled, prosperous life (1 Kings 5:5; Micah 4:4). Their ruin means the end of that life.

decisions.choice: a thicket ... the animals of the field: cultivated land going wild
decisions.reason: Untended vineyards and orchards become overgrown, and wild animals feed in them (Isaiah 5:5-6; 7:23-25). In 2:20 the LORD makes a covenant with the same animals for his people's safety.

decisions.choice: my pay (B); what my lovers paid me (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "wages". Balanced and Readable use "pay", which brings out the payment for her favors (m1) without making the wording cruder than the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "몸값" (L); "화대" (B)
decisions.reason: *'etnah* is a prostitute's pay, as the shared footnote says; "품삯" would hide that.

decisions.choice: "ujira" (L, B); "malipo" (R)
decisions.reason: The *etnah* is a prostitute's pay (m1); "ujira" is wages for a service, without the softer "zawadi" (gift).

source.text: וּפָקַדְתִּ֣י עָלֶ֗יהָ אֶת־יְמֵ֤י הַבְּעָלִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּקְטִ֣יר לָהֶ֔ם וַתַּ֤עַד נִזְמָהּ֙ וְחֶלְיָתָ֔הּ וַתֵּ֖לֶךְ אַחֲרֵ֣י מְאַהֲבֶ֑יהָ וְאֹתִ֥י שָׁכְחָ֖ה נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And I will visit on her [the] days of the Baals, when she burned offerings to them, and she adorned herself [with] her ring and her jewelry, and she went after her lovers, and me she forgot, declaration of Yahweh.

en.L: And I will visit on her the days of the Baals, when she burned offerings to them, \q and adorned herself with her ring and her jewelry, \q and she went after her lovers; \q but {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} she forgot, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: I will punish her for the feast days of the Baals, when she burned offerings to them, \q put on her rings and her jewelry, \q and went after her lovers, \q but forgot {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: I will punish her for all the times she burned offerings to the Baals. \q She put on her rings and her jewelry \q and went after her lovers. \q But she forgot {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y le pediré cuentas por los días de los baales, en que les quemaba ofrendas, \q y se adornaba con su anillo y sus joyas, \q y se iba tras sus amantes; \q pero de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} se olvidó, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: La castigaré por los días de fiesta de los baales, cuando les quemaba ofrendas, \q se ponía sus anillos y sus joyas \q y se iba tras sus amantes, \q pero se olvidaba de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: La castigaré por todas las veces que quemó ofrendas a los baales. \q Se ponía sus anillos y sus joyas \q y se iba tras sus amantes. \q Pero de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} se olvidó, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et je visiterai sur elle les jours des Baals, où elle leur brûlait des offrandes, \q et se parait de son anneau et de ses bijoux, \q et allait après ses amants ; \q mais {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, elle {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a oublié, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Je la punirai pour les jours de fête des Baals, où elle leur brûlait des offrandes, \q se parait de ses anneaux et de ses bijoux \q et suivait ses amants, \q tandis qu’elle {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}oubliait, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Je la punirai pour toutes les fois où elle a brûlé des offrandes pour les Baals. \q Elle mettait ses anneaux et ses bijoux \q et elle suivait ses amants. \q Mais elle {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a oublié, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

ko.L: 내가 바알들의 날들을 그 여자에게 갚겠다. 그때에 그 여자는 그것들에게 분향하고, \q 자기 고리와 패물로 몸을 꾸미고, \q 자기 애인들을 따라갔다. \q 나를, 그 여자는 잊어버렸다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 바알들의 축제일에 그 여자가 바알들에게 향을 피우고, \q 고리와 패물로 몸을 꾸미고, \q 애인들을 따라다니며, \q 나를 잊어버렸으니, 내가 그 여자를 벌하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 그 여자가 바알들에게 향을 피운 그 모든 날 때문에 나는 그 여자를 벌하겠다. \q 그 여자는 고리와 패물로 몸을 꾸미고 \q 애인들을 따라갔다. \q 그러나 그 여자는 나를 잊어버렸다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ thăm phạt nàng về những ngày của các Ba-anh, khi nàng đốt [của lễ] cho chúng, \q và trang sức mình bằng nhẫn và đồ nữ trang, \q và đi theo các tình nhân mình; \q còn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} thì nàng đã quên, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Ta sẽ trừng phạt nàng về những ngày lễ của các Ba-anh, khi nàng đốt của lễ dâng cho chúng, \q đeo nhẫn và đồ trang sức, \q rồi đi theo các tình nhân mình, \q nhưng lại quên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Ta sẽ trừng phạt nàng vì mọi lần nàng đốt của lễ dâng cho các Ba-anh. \q Nàng đeo nhẫn và đồ trang sức \q rồi đi theo các tình nhân mình. \q Nhưng nàng đã quên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

sw.L: Nami nitamwadhibu kwa siku za Mabaali, alipowafukizia [sadaka], \q akajipamba kwa pete yake na vito vyake, \q akawafuata wapenzi wake; \q lakini {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} alinisahau, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Nitamwadhibu kwa ajili ya sikukuu za Mabaali, alipowafukizia sadaka, \q akavaa pete zake na vito vyake, \q akawafuata wapenzi wake, \q lakini akanisahau {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Nitamwadhibu kwa nyakati zote alizowafukizia Mabaali sadaka. \q Alivaa pete zake na vito vyake, \q akawafuata wapenzi wake. \q Lakini alinisahau {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: the Baals: the many local forms of the god Baal
decisions.reason: Baal, "lord" or "master", was the Canaanite storm god, believed to bring rain and fertility. He was worshiped at many shrines, each with its own Baal, so the Bible often speaks of "the Baals" (Judges 2:11; Jeremiah 2:23). "The days of the Baals" are their festival days, which had replaced the LORD's (2:13).

decisions.choice: burned offerings: made offerings go up in smoke
decisions.reason: The verb means to make something go up in smoke. It is used for burning incense and for burning parts of sacrifices on the altar. Either may be meant here; both were part of the worship of the Baals.

decisions.choice: ring: a nose ring or an earring
decisions.reason: The word is used for both (Genesis 24:47; Exodus 32:2). She adorns herself to meet her lovers, as a woman for a feast.

decisions.choice: me she forgot: "me" stands first for emphasis
decisions.reason: The Hebrew puts "me" first: of all things, the LORD is the one she forgot. Forgetting the LORD is the failure the covenant warned of (Deuteronomy 8:11-19).

decisions.choice: punish (B, R); feast days (B)
decisions.reason: "Visit on her" means to punish her for (as 1:4). Literal keeps "visit". Balanced says "feast days" for "days", since the days of the Baals are their festivals (m1). "Declares the LORD" is "says the LORD" at Readable, as set for the prophets.

decisions.choice: "declara el SEÑOR" (L); "afirma el SEÑOR" (B); "dice el SEÑOR" (R)
decisions.reason: The formula ne'um YHWH as the terms notes set it for Spanish, always after a comma, at every use in Hosea and Joel.

decisions.choice: "le pediré cuentas por"
decisions.reason: As at 1:4, Literal gives the Hebrew "visit on" as calling to account; Balanced and Readable say "castigar".

decisions.choice: "déclare le SEIGNEUR" (L, B), "dit le SEIGNEUR" (R) for ne'um YHWH, throughout Hosea and Joel
decisions.reason: The formula as the term sheet carries it over from Isaiah and Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: "CHÚA phán vậy" (L, B); "CHÚA phán" (R)
decisions.reason: The formula for ne'um YHWH settled in the Isaiah and Jeremiah note and kept through the Twelve; mid-verse it follows a comma.

decisions.choice: "các Ba-anh"
decisions.reason: The plural as published (1 Samuel 7:4; 1 Kings 18:18).

decisions.choice: "바알들"; "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다" (L), "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다" (B, R), as its own sentence
decisions.reason: The prophets' formula for *ne'um YHWH*, as Isaiah and Jeremiah; the plural "바알들" as Kings.

decisions.choice: "asema BWANA" (L, B); "anasema BWANA" (R)
decisions.reason: *Ne'um YHWH* as in Isaiah and Jeremiah (term sheet), kept in the -a- form through Hosea and Joel.

decisions.choice: "lakini mimi alinisahau"
decisions.reason: Swahili can front the free pronoun as the Hebrew fronts "me" (m4); Balanced and Readable put it after the verb, where it still stresses the object.

source.text: לָכֵ֗ן הִנֵּ֤ה אָֽנֹכִי֙ מְפַתֶּ֔יהָ וְהֹֽלַכְתִּ֖יהָ הַמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְדִבַּרְתִּ֖י עַללִבָּֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore here I [am] alluring her, and I will lead her into the wilderness, and I will speak to her heart.

en.L: Therefore, look, I am going to allure her, \q and I will lead her into the wilderness, \q and I will speak to her heart.
en.B: Therefore I am going to woo her; \q I will lead her into the wilderness \q and speak tenderly to her.
