en.R: So now I will win her back. \q I will lead her into the desert \q and speak lovingly to her.

es.L: Por tanto, he aquí, yo la seduciré, \q y la llevaré al desierto, \q y hablaré a su corazón.
es.B: Por eso voy a enamorarla; \q la llevaré al desierto \q y le hablaré con ternura.
es.R: Por eso ahora la conquistaré de nuevo. \q La llevaré al desierto \q y le hablaré con cariño.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi, voici, je vais la séduire, \q et je la conduirai au désert, \q et je parlerai à son cœur.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi je vais la séduire ; \q je la conduirai au désert \q et je lui parlerai avec tendresse.
fr.R: Alors je vais la reconquérir. \q Je la conduirai dans le désert \q et je lui parlerai avec amour.

ko.L: 그러므로 보라, 내가 그 여자를 달래어 \q 광야로 데리고 가서 \q 그 여자의 마음에 말하겠다.
ko.B: 그러므로 내가 그 여자를 달래어 \q 광야로 데리고 가서 \q 다정하게 말하겠다.
ko.R: 그래서 이제 나는 그 여자의 마음을 다시 얻겠다. \q 그 여자를 광야로 데리고 가서 \q 사랑을 담아 말하겠다.

vi.L: Vì vậy, này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ quyến dụ nàng, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ dẫn nàng vào hoang mạc, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ nói với lòng nàng.
vi.B: Vì vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ dỗ dành nàng; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ dẫn nàng vào hoang mạc \q và nói lời âu yếm với nàng.
vi.R: Vì vậy, bây giờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ chinh phục nàng trở lại. \q Ta sẽ dẫn nàng vào sa mạc \q và nói những lời yêu thương với nàng.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo, tazama, nitamshawishi, \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitamwongoza mpaka nyikani, \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitasema na moyo wake.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo nitambembeleza; \q nitamwongoza mpaka nyikani \q na kusema naye kwa upole.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo sasa nitamrudisha {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}. \q Nitamwongoza mpaka jangwani \q na kuzungumza naye kwa upendo.

decisions.choice: allure: persuade, win over
decisions.reason: The verb means to persuade or entice, sometimes to deceive. It is used of a man winning a young woman (Exodus 22:15), and Jeremiah uses it when he says the LORD persuaded him (Jeremiah 20:7). Here the LORD sets out to win his wife's heart again.

decisions.choice: into the wilderness: back to where the covenant began
decisions.reason: The wilderness was where the LORD led Israel after the exodus and made his covenant with them, the time of first love (Jeremiah 2:2). After the barrenness threatened in 2:5, the wilderness here is a place of new beginning. 2:17 makes the link to Egypt explicit.

decisions.choice: speak to her heart: speak tenderly, to comfort and win her
decisions.reason: The phrase is used for a man speaking to win a woman (Genesis 34:3), for kind words that comfort (Ruth 2:13), and for the LORD's comfort to Jerusalem (Isaiah 40:2).

decisions.choice: woo (B); win her back (R); speak tenderly (B); speak lovingly (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the verb and the idiom mean here (m1, m3). Literal keeps "allure" and "speak to her heart". The word "look" (Literal) is the usual rendering of the Hebrew word that calls attention; Balanced and Readable leave it out.

decisions.choice: "enamorarla" (B); "la conquistaré de nuevo" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb means to persuade or win over; Literal keeps "seducir", which in Spanish can sound like deceit, so Balanced and Readable use the words of courtship, as the English "woo" and "win her back".

decisions.choice: "nitambembeleza" (I will woo her)
decisions.reason: "Bembeleza" is the ordinary word for coaxing a loved one with tender words; Literal keeps "shawishi" (allure, persuade).

source.text: וְנָתַ֨תִּי לָ֤הּ אֶת־כְּרָמֶ֨יהָ֙ מִשָּׁ֔ם וְאֶת־עֵ֥מֶק עָכ֖וֹר לְפֶ֣תַח תִּקְוָ֑ה וְעָ֤נְתָה שָּׁ֨מָּה֙ כִּימֵ֣י נְעוּרֶ֔יהָ וִּכְי֖וֹםעֲלֹתָ֥הּ מֵאֶֽרֶץ־מִצְרָֽיִם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And I will give to her her vineyards from there, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope; and she will answer there as [in the] days of her youth, and as [the] day of her coming up from [the] land of Egypt.

en.L: And I will give her her vineyards from there, \q and the valley of Achor as a door of hope; \q and she will answer there as in the days of her youth, \q and as on the day she came up from the land of Egypt.
en.B: There I will give her back her vineyards \q and make the valley of Achor a door of hope. \q There she will respond as in the days of her youth, \q as on the day she came up from the land of Egypt.
en.R: There I will give her vineyards back to her. \q I will make the valley of Achor, whose name means trouble, a doorway of hope. \q There she will respond to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} as she did when she was young, \q when she came out of the land of Egypt.

es.L: Y le daré sus viñas desde allí, \q y el valle de Acor como puerta de esperanza; \q y allí responderá como en los días de su juventud, \q y como el día en que subió de la tierra de Egipto.
es.B: Allí le devolveré sus viñas \q y haré del valle de Acor una puerta de esperanza. \q Allí responderá como en los días de su juventud, \q como el día en que subió de la tierra de Egipto.
es.R: Allí le devolveré sus viñas. \q Haré que el valle de Acor, cuyo nombre significa «desgracia», sea una puerta de esperanza. \q Allí {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} responderá como cuando era joven, \q cuando salió de la tierra de Egipto.

fr.L: Et je lui donnerai ses vignes à partir de là, \q et la vallée d’Akor comme une porte d’espérance ; \q et elle répondra là comme aux jours de sa jeunesse, \q et comme au jour où elle est montée du pays d’Égypte.
fr.B: Là, je lui rendrai ses vignes \q et je ferai de la vallée d’Akor une porte d’espérance. \q Là, elle répondra comme aux jours de sa jeunesse, \q comme au jour où elle est montée du pays d’Égypte.
fr.R: Là, je lui rendrai ses vignes. \q Je ferai de la vallée d’Akor, dont le nom veut dire « Malheur », une porte d’espérance. \q Là, elle {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} répondra comme quand elle était jeune, \q quand elle est sortie du pays d’Égypte.

ko.L: 그곳에서 내가 그 여자에게 그 여자의 포도원들을 주고, \q 아골 골짜기를 소망의 문으로 [주겠다]. \q 그 여자는 그곳에서 자기 젊은 날처럼, \q 이집트 땅에서 올라오던 날처럼 대답할 것이다.
ko.B: 그곳에서 내가 그 여자의 포도원들을 돌려주고, \q 아골 골짜기를 소망의 문으로 만들겠다. \q 그 여자는 그곳에서 젊은 날처럼, \q 이집트 땅에서 올라오던 날처럼 나에게 응답할 것이다.
ko.R: 그곳에서 나는 그 여자에게 포도원을 돌려주겠다. \q '괴로움'이라는 뜻의 아골 골짜기를 소망의 문으로 만들겠다. \q 그 여자는 그곳에서 젊었을 때처럼 나에게 응답할 것이다. \q 이집트 땅에서 나오던 때처럼 그렇게 할 것이다.

vi.L: Và từ nơi đó {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ban cho nàng các vườn nho của nàng, \q và thung lũng A-cô làm cửa hy vọng; \q và tại đó nàng sẽ đáp lời như trong những ngày tuổi trẻ của nàng, \q và như ngày nàng đi lên từ đất Ai Cập.
vi.B: Tại đó {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trả lại cho nàng các vườn nho \q và biến thung lũng A-cô thành cửa hy vọng. \q Tại đó nàng sẽ đáp lời như thuở còn xuân xanh, \q như ngày nàng từ đất Ai Cập đi lên.
vi.R: Tại đó {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trả lại cho nàng các vườn nho. \q Ta sẽ biến thung lũng A-cô, nghĩa là "tai họa", thành cửa ngõ của hy vọng. \q Tại đó nàng sẽ đáp lại {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} như hồi nàng còn trẻ, \q khi nàng ra khỏi đất Ai Cập.

sw.L: Nami nitampa mashamba yake ya mizabibu kutoka huko, \q na bonde la Akori kuwa mlango wa tumaini; \q naye ataitikia huko kama katika siku za ujana wake, \q na kama siku ile alipopanda kutoka nchi ya Misri.
sw.B: Huko nitamrudishia mashamba yake ya mizabibu, \q na kulifanya bonde la Akori kuwa mlango wa tumaini. \q Huko ataitikia kama katika siku za ujana wake, \q kama siku ile alipopanda kutoka nchi ya Misri.
sw.R: Huko nitamrudishia mashamba yake ya mizabibu. \q Nitalifanya bonde la Akori, ambalo jina lake maana yake ni taabu, kuwa mlango wa tumaini. \q Huko ataniitikia kama alivyofanya alipokuwa msichana, \q alipotoka katika nchi ya Misri.

decisions.choice: the valley of Achor: "the valley of trouble", made a door of hope
decisions.reason: Achor means "trouble". The valley got its name when Achan was punished there for taking what was devoted to the LORD, the first sin after Israel entered the land (Joshua 7:24-26). The place that recalled trouble at the entrance to the land becomes an entrance of hope. Isaiah 65:10 also promises the valley of Achor as a place of rest.

decisions.choice: answer: respond to the LORD's wooing
decisions.reason: The verb most often means "answer" or "respond", which suits the LORD speaking to her heart (2:16) and the chain of answering in 2:23-24. A verb with the same letters means "sing" (Exodus 15:21; 32:18), and some read "she will sing there", as Israel sang after crossing the sea. The sense "respond" is taken here.

decisions.choice: the days of her youth, the day she came up from Egypt: Israel's first love
decisions.reason: The exodus and the wilderness journey are pictured as the time of Israel's youth and engagement to the LORD (Jeremiah 2:2; Ezekiel 16:8). The return to the wilderness (2:16) will be a new exodus.

decisions.choice: from there: once she is there in the wilderness
decisions.reason: "From there" may mean "from that place" (as she comes from the wilderness into the land) or "from that time on". Either way the gifts come after the LORD has brought her into the wilderness.

decisions.choice: There ... back (B, R); respond (B, R); to me (R); whose name means trouble (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "There" for "from there" and "back", since the vineyards were hers before (2:14). They say "respond" for "answer", and Readable adds "to me", the one she responds to. Readable gives the meaning of Achor in the text, which the footnote gives at the other levels (m1).

decisions.choice: "el valle de Acor"; R "cuyo nombre significa «desgracia»"
decisions.reason: The published Spanish form (Joshua 7; Isaiah 65:10); Readable explains the name, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "thung lũng A-cô"; R "nghĩa là 'tai họa'"
decisions.reason: The place name as published (Joshua 7:26); Readable gives its meaning as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "'괴로움'이라는 뜻의 아골 골짜기" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English Readable, which explains the name; L and B leave it to the footnote.

source.text: וְהָיָ֤ה בַיּוֹם־הַהוּא֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה תִּקְרְאִ֖י אִישִׁ֑י וְלֹֽא־תִקְרְאִי־לִ֥י ע֖וֹד בַּעְלִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be in the day the that, declaration of Yahweh, you will call, My husband, and not you will call to me again, My baal.

en.L: And it will be on that day, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, [that] you will call, "My husband," \q and you will no longer call {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, "My baal."
en.B: On that day, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, you will call {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} "My husband"; \q you will no longer call {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} "My Baal."
en.R: At that time, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, you will call {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} "My husband." \q You will never again call {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} "My Baal," which means "My master."

es.L: Y sucederá en aquel día, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, [que] {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} llamarás: «Marido mío», \q y no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} llamarás más: «Mi baal».
es.B: Aquel día, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} llamarás «Marido mío»; \q ya no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} llamarás «Mi Baal».
es.R: En ese tiempo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} llamarás «Mi marido». \q Nunca más {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} llamarás «Mi Baal», que significa «mi amo».

fr.L: Et il arrivera en ce jour-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, [que] tu appelleras : « Mon mari », \q et tu ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appelleras plus : « Mon baal ».
fr.B: Ce jour-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, tu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appelleras « Mon mari » ; \q tu ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appelleras plus « Mon Baal ».
fr.R: En ce temps-là, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, tu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appelleras « Mon mari ». \q Tu ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appelleras plus jamais « Mon Baal », ce qui veut dire « Mon maître ».

ko.L: 그날에 이렇게 될 것이다. 너는 [나를] "내 남편"이라고 부르고, \q 다시는 나를 "내 주인"이라고 부르지 않을 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 그날에 너는 나를 "내 남편"이라고 부르고, \q 다시는 나를 "내 주인"이라고 부르지 않을 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 그때에 너는 나를 "내 남편"이라고 부를 것이다. \q 다시는 나를 "내 주인"이라는 뜻의 "내 바알"이라고 부르지 않을 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

vi.L: Và sẽ xảy ra trong ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, ngươi sẽ gọi: "Chồng tôi," \q và ngươi sẽ không còn gọi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}: "Ba-anh của tôi."
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, con sẽ gọi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là "Chồng tôi"; \q con sẽ không còn gọi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là "Ba-anh của tôi" nữa.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, con sẽ gọi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là "Chồng tôi." \q Con sẽ không bao giờ gọi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là "Ba-anh của tôi" nữa, nghĩa là "Chủ của tôi."

sw.L: Na itakuwa katika siku ile, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, [kwamba] utaniita, "Mume wangu," \q wala hutaniita tena, "baali wangu."
sw.B: Siku hiyo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, utaniita "Mume wangu"; \q hutaniita tena "Baali wangu."
sw.R: Wakati huo, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, utaniita "Mume wangu." \q Hutaniita tena kamwe "Baali wangu," maana yake "bwana wangu."

decisions.choice: My husband, not My baal: a play on the name of Baal
decisions.reason: Hebrew had two common words a wife could use for her husband: *ish*, "man, husband", and *baal*, "master, owner, husband". The second is also the name of the god Baal. The LORD says that his wife will call him *ishi*, "my husband", and no longer *baali*, "my master" or "my Baal". The word must not be used for him, because it would blur the LORD with Baal, and because the relationship will be one of closeness, not ownership.

decisions.choice: baal may have been used of the LORD himself
decisions.reason: Some Israelites of this period gave their children names with "baal" in them, such as Eshbaal, Saul's son (1 Chronicles 8:33), and Bealiah, one of David's men (1 Chronicles 12:6), whose name means "the LORD is master". Calling the LORD "my baal" may have seemed harmless, but it opened the way to confusing him with Baal. The next verse removes the name altogether.

decisions.choice: you will call: the LORD now speaks to his wife directly
decisions.reason: The verbs are addressed to a woman. After speaking about her in the third person, the LORD turns to her, as he did for a moment in 2:8.

decisions.choice: My baal (L); My Baal (B, R); which means "My master" (R)
decisions.reason: Every level keeps the play by keeping the word baal, as the terms note asks. Literal writes it in lowercase as an ordinary word; Balanced and Readable capitalize it, so the reader sees the god's name; Readable adds what the word means. The footnote explains it (m1). Literal does not supply "me" after the first "call", which the Hebrew leaves out; Balanced and Readable supply it.

decisions.choice: "Marido mío" / "Mi baal" (L); "Marido mío" / "Mi Baal" (B); "Mi marido" / "Mi Baal, que significa «mi amo»" (R)
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets: every level keeps the play on the name Baal, which as a common word means "master" or "husband"; Literal writes it lowercase as a common word, Balanced and Readable as the name, and Readable explains it.

decisions.choice: "llamarás" (tú)
decisions.reason: The LORD speaks to his wife directly, in the singular, so Spanish uses tú.

decisions.choice: "Mon mari" / "Mon baal" (L), "Mon Baal" (B, R), with "ce qui veut dire « Mon maître »" at R
decisions.reason: As the term sheet: keeping the word baal keeps the play on the god's name that the footnote explains; "en ce jour-là" (L), "ce jour-là" (B), "en ce temps-là" (R) as the prophets' formula.

decisions.choice: "Chồng tôi" / "Ba-anh của tôi"; R adds nghĩa là "Chủ của tôi"
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording: "Ba-anh" keeps the play on the god's name, and Readable explains it, as the English Readable does; the footnote gives the wordplay.

decisions.choice: God to Israel, his bride, in 2:16-25: "ngươi" (L), "con" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The terms note gives "con" at Balanced and Readable in Hosea's tender passages (2:16-25; 11:8-9; 14:5-9). In a marriage image "con" from a husband may sound odd to a Vietnamese reader; a reviewer should decide whether the bride passages (2:18-22) keep "con" or take another form.

decisions.choice: "내 남편" and "내 주인" (L, B); R gives "내 바알" with its meaning in the text
decisions.reason: *Ba'li* means "my master" and is also the god's name; Korean cannot say both in one word, so L and B say "내 주인" and the footnote gives "my Baal", while R, like the English Readable, names Baal and explains it.

decisions.choice: "baali wangu" (L), "Baali wangu" (B, R); R adds "maana yake 'bwana wangu'"
decisions.reason: The play on Baal's name (m1) is kept by writing the word itself, as the English does. Swahili "bwana" means both master and husband, which fits the Hebrew word's range; the footnote explains the play.

source.text: וַהֲסִרֹתִ֛י אֶת־שְׁמ֥וֹת הַבְּעָלִ֖ים מִפִּ֑יהָ וְלֹֽא־יִזָּכְר֥וּ ע֖וֹד בִּשְׁמָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will remove [the] names of the Baals from her mouth, and not they will be remembered again by their name.

en.L: And I will remove the names of the Baals from her mouth, \q and they will no longer be remembered by their name.
en.B: I will remove the names of the Baals from her mouth, \q and they will no longer be invoked by name.
en.R: I will take the names of the Baals out of her mouth. \q No one will ever call on them by name again.

es.L: Y quitaré de su boca los nombres de los baales, \q y nunca más serán recordados por su nombre.
es.B: Quitaré de su boca los nombres de los baales, \q y nunca más serán invocados por su nombre.
es.R: Le quitaré de la boca los nombres de los baales. \q Nadie volverá a invocarlos por su nombre.

fr.L: Et j’ôterai les noms des Baals de sa bouche, \q et on ne se souviendra plus d’eux par leur nom.
fr.B: J’ôterai de sa bouche les noms des Baals, \q et on ne les invoquera plus par leur nom.
fr.R: J’enlèverai de sa bouche les noms des Baals. \q Plus personne ne les appellera par leur nom pour les prier.

ko.L: 내가 바알들의 이름을 그 여자의 입에서 없애 버리겠다. \q 그것들이 다시는 그 이름으로 기억되지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 바알들의 이름을 그 여자의 입에서 없애 버리겠다. \q 다시는 아무도 그 이름을 부르지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 바알들의 이름을 그 여자의 입에서 지워 버리겠다. \q 다시는 아무도 그 이름을 부르며 기도하지 않을 것이다.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cất bỏ danh các Ba-anh khỏi miệng nàng, \q và chúng sẽ không còn được nhắc đến bằng tên của chúng nữa.
vi.B: Ta sẽ cất bỏ danh các Ba-anh khỏi miệng nàng, \q và người ta sẽ không còn khấn vái chúng bằng tên nữa.
vi.R: Ta sẽ cất tên các Ba-anh khỏi miệng nàng. \q Sẽ không còn ai kêu cầu tên chúng nữa.

sw.L: Nami nitayaondoa majina ya Mabaali kinywani mwake, \q nao hawatakumbukwa tena kwa jina lao.
sw.B: Nitayaondoa majina ya Mabaali kinywani mwake, \q wala majina yao hayatatajwa tena katika ibada.
sw.R: Nitayaondoa majina ya Mabaali kinywani mwake. \q Hakuna mtu atakayewaita tena kwa majina yao.

decisions.choice: remove the names of the Baals: the command of Exodus 23:13 fulfilled
decisions.reason: The law said: "Make no mention of the names of other gods; let them not be heard on your lips" (Exodus 23:13). What Israel failed to keep, the LORD will bring about himself. Zechariah 13:2 makes a similar promise.

decisions.choice: be remembered by their name: be called on in worship
decisions.reason: To "remember" or "mention" a god's name is to invoke it in prayer, oaths and praise (Joshua 23:7; Psalm 20:8). The Baals will be forgotten in worship.

decisions.choice: invoked (B); call on (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "remembered by name" means here (m2).

source.text: וְכָרַתִּ֨י לָהֶ֤ם בְּרִית֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא עִם־חַיַּ֤ת הַשָּׂדֶה֙ וְעִם־ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְרֶ֖מֶשׂ הָֽאֲדָמָ֑ה וְקֶ֨שֶׁת וְחֶ֤רֶב וּמִלְחָמָה֙ אֶשְׁבּ֣וֹר מִן־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְהִשְׁכַּבְתִּ֖ים לָבֶֽטַח׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will make for them a covenant in the day the that with [the] animal of the field and with [the] bird of the heavens and [the] creeping thing of the ground; and bow and sword and battle I will break from the land, and I will make them lie down in security.

en.L: And I will make for them a covenant on that day \q with the beast of the field and with the bird of the sky \q and the creeping thing of the ground; \q and bow and sword and battle I will shatter from the land, \q and I will make them lie down in security.
en.B: On that day I will make a covenant on their behalf \q with the wild animals and the birds of the sky \q and the creatures that move along the ground. \q I will break bow and sword and battle and remove them from the land, \q and I will let them lie down in safety.
en.R: At that time I will make an agreement for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people \q with the wild animals and the birds \q and the creatures that crawl on the ground. \q I will put an end to bows and swords and war in the land, \q so that {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people can lie down and be safe.

es.L: Y haré para ellos un pacto en aquel día \q con las bestias del campo y con las aves del cielo \q y con los reptiles de la tierra; \q y quebraré de la tierra el arco, la espada y la guerra, \q y los haré dormir seguros.
es.B: Aquel día haré en su favor un pacto \q con los animales salvajes y las aves del cielo \q y los animales que se arrastran por el suelo. \q Romperé el arco, la espada y la guerra, y los quitaré de la tierra, \q y los dejaré descansar seguros.
es.R: En ese tiempo haré un acuerdo en favor de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo \q con los animales salvajes y con las aves \q y con los animales que se arrastran por el suelo. \q Acabaré con los arcos, las espadas y la guerra en el país, \q para que {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo pueda acostarse y estar seguro.

fr.L: Et je conclurai pour eux une alliance en ce jour-là \q avec la bête des champs et avec l’oiseau du ciel \q et ce qui rampe sur le sol ; \q et l’arc et l’épée et la guerre, je [les] briserai [et les ôterai] du pays, \q et je les ferai reposer en sécurité.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, je conclurai en leur faveur une alliance \q avec les bêtes sauvages et les oiseaux du ciel \q et les bêtes qui se déplacent sur le sol. \q Je briserai l’arc, l’épée et la guerre, et je les ôterai du pays, \q et je les ferai reposer en sécurité.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, je ferai une alliance pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple \q avec les animaux sauvages et les oiseaux \q et les petites bêtes qui rampent sur le sol. \q Je mettrai fin aux arcs, aux épées et à la guerre dans le pays, \q pour que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple puisse se coucher en sécurité.

ko.L: 그날에 내가 그들을 위하여 \q 들짐승과 하늘의 새와 \q 땅에 기는 것과 언약을 맺겠다. \q 활과 칼과 전쟁을 내가 그 땅에서 꺾어 버리고, \q 그들을 안전하게 눕게 하겠다.
ko.B: 그날에 내가 그들을 위하여 \q 들짐승과 하늘의 새와 \q 땅 위를 기어 다니는 것들과 언약을 맺겠다. \q 활과 칼을 꺾고 전쟁을 그 땅에서 없애서, \q 그들이 안전하게 누워 쉬게 하겠다.
ko.R: 그때에 나는 내 백성을 위하여 \q 들짐승과 새와 \q 땅 위를 기어 다니는 것들과 약속을 맺겠다. \q 그 땅에서 활과 칼과 전쟁을 없애 버리겠다. \q 그래서 내 백성이 안전하게 누워 쉴 수 있게 하겠다.

vi.L: Và trong ngày ấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lập cho họ một giao ước \q với thú đồng và với chim trời \q và loài bò sát trên đất; \q và cung, gươm và chiến trận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ bẻ gãy khỏi xứ, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho họ nằm xuống an toàn.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ vì họ mà lập giao ước \q với thú hoang và chim trời \q cùng các loài bò sát trên đất. \q Ta sẽ bẻ gãy cung, gươm và chiến tranh, dẹp chúng khỏi xứ, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho họ nằm nghỉ yên ổn.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lập một giao ước cho dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} \q với thú hoang và chim chóc \q cùng các loài bò sát trên mặt đất. \q Ta sẽ chấm dứt cung tên, gươm giáo và chiến tranh trong xứ, \q để dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} có thể nằm nghỉ an toàn.

sw.L: Nami nitafanya agano kwa ajili yao katika siku ile \q pamoja na wanyama wa mwituni na ndege wa angani \q na viumbe vitambaavyo ardhini; \q na upinde na upanga na vita nitavivunjilia mbali katika nchi, \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawalaza salama.
sw.B: Siku hiyo nitafanya agano kwa ajili yao \q na wanyama wa porini na ndege wa angani \q na viumbe vinavyotambaa ardhini. \q Nitavunja upinde na upanga na vita na kuviondoa katika nchi, \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawalaza kwa usalama.
sw.R: Wakati huo nitafanya mapatano kwa ajili ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} \q na wanyama wa porini na ndege \q na viumbe vinavyotambaa ardhini. \q Nitakomesha pinde na panga na vita katika nchi, \q ili watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} walale salama.

decisions.choice: a covenant with the animals, birds and creeping things: creation at peace with God's people
decisions.reason: The three groups are the living creatures of the creation story (Genesis 1:30) and of God's covenant after the flood (Genesis 9:9-10). The animals that were to devour the vineyards (2:14) will no longer threaten. Leviticus 26:6 and Ezekiel 34:25 promise the same: harmful beasts removed and the people living safely.

decisions.choice: bow and sword and battle I will break: 1:5 reversed
decisions.reason: In 1:5 the LORD broke Israel's bow in defeat. Here he breaks the weapons of war themselves, so that no one can attack his people. Compare Psalm 46:10; Isaiah 2:4.

decisions.choice: for them ... make them lie down: the people of Israel
decisions.reason: "Them" is the people the woman stands for. The covenant is made by the LORD on their behalf with the animals. "Lie down in security" is the language of the covenant blessing (Leviticus 26:5-6).

decisions.choice: break ... and remove them from the land (B); put an end to ... in the land (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "break from the land", joining two ideas in one verb. Balanced keeps "break" and adds "remove"; Readable says what both mean together.

decisions.choice: my people (R); agreement (R)
decisions.reason: Readable names "them" as "my people" (m3) and says "agreement" for "covenant", as a plain word for a binding promise.

decisions.choice: "un pacto" (L, B); "un acuerdo" (R)
decisions.reason: Covenant is "pacto" in the Spanish prophets; Readable says "acuerdo", as the English Readable says "agreement".

decisions.choice: "une alliance" at Readable
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "agreement"; French "alliance" is the plain word for a covenant and the one the style guide keeps at every level.

source.text: וְאֵרַשְׂתִּ֥יךְ לִ֖י לְעוֹלָ֑ם וְאֵרַשְׂתִּ֥יךְ לִי֙ בְּצֶ֣דֶק וּבְמִשְׁפָּ֔ט וּבְחֶ֖סֶד וּֽבְרַחֲמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will betroth you to me forever; and I will betroth you to me in righteousness and in justice and in covenant loyalty and in compassion.

en.L: And I will betroth you to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} forever; \q and I will betroth you to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} in righteousness and in justice, \q and in loyal love and in compassion.
en.B: I will betroth you to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} forever. \q I will betroth you to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} with righteousness and justice, \q with loyal love and compassion.
en.R: I will make you {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} bride forever. \q I will make you {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} bride, and I will bring to our marriage what is right and fair, \q faithful love and compassion.

es.L: Y te desposaré conmigo para siempre; \q te desposaré conmigo en justicia y en derecho, \q y en amor leal y en compasión.
es.B: Te desposaré conmigo para siempre. \q Te desposaré conmigo con justicia y derecho, \q con amor fiel y compasión.
es.R: Te haré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} esposa para siempre. \q Te haré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} esposa, y traeré a nuestro matrimonio lo que es justo y correcto, \q amor fiel y compasión.

fr.L: Et je te fiancerai à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} pour toujours ; \q et je te fiancerai à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} par la justice et par le droit, \q et par l’amour loyal et par la compassion.
fr.B: Je ferai de toi {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fiancée pour toujours. \q Je ferai de toi {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fiancée par la justice et le droit, \q par l’amour fidèle et la compassion.
fr.R: Je ferai de toi {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} femme pour toujours. \q Je ferai de toi {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} femme, et j’apporterai à notre mariage ce qui est juste et équitable, \q l’amour fidèle et la compassion.

ko.L: 내가 너와 영원히 약혼하겠다. \q 의와 정의로 너와 약혼하고, \q 한결같은 사랑과 긍휼로 [너와 약혼하겠다].
ko.B: 내가 너를 영원히 아내로 맞겠다. \q 의와 정의로, \q 한결같은 사랑과 긍휼로 너를 아내로 맞겠다.
ko.R: 나는 너를 영원히 내 신부로 삼겠다. \q 너를 내 신부로 삼고, 옳고 바른 일과 \q 변함없는 사랑과 자비를 우리 결혼에 가져오겠다.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ hứa hôn ngươi cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đến đời đời; \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ hứa hôn ngươi cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong sự công chính và trong công lý, \q và trong tình yêu thương thành tín và trong lòng thương xót.
vi.B: Ta sẽ cưới con làm vợ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mãi mãi. \q Ta sẽ cưới con làm vợ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bằng sự công chính và công lý, \q bằng tình yêu thương thành tín và lòng thương xót.
vi.R: Ta sẽ cưới con làm vợ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đời đời. \q Ta sẽ cưới con làm vợ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem đến cho cuộc hôn nhân của chúng ta điều ngay thẳng và công bằng, \q tình thương không hề thay đổi và lòng thương xót.

sw.L: Nami nitakuposa uwe {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} milele; \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitakuposa uwe {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kwa haki na kwa hukumu, \q na kwa upendo usiokoma na kwa huruma.
sw.B: Nitakuposa uwe {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} milele. \q Nitakuposa uwe {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kwa uadilifu na haki, \q kwa upendo usiokoma na huruma.
sw.R: Nitakufanya uwe bibi arusi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} milele. \q Nitakufanya uwe bibi arusi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaleta katika ndoa yetu yaliyo ya haki na ya adili, \q upendo usiokoma na huruma.

decisions.choice: betroth: bind as a wife in the agreement that begins a marriage
decisions.reason: Betrothal was the binding agreement made before a couple lived together, sealed by a payment to the bride's family (Deuteronomy 22:23-29; 2 Samuel 3:14). It was as binding as marriage. The LORD does not simply take back a wife who has been unfaithful; he begins again as if with a young bride, and "forever" means there will be no breaking of this bond. The verb is said three times (2:21-22).

decisions.choice: in righteousness and justice, loyal love and compassion: the bride-price the LORD pays, and the way he will keep the marriage
decisions.reason: The small word translated "in" or "with" is the one used for the price paid for a bride in 2 Samuel 3:14. Read that way, these qualities are the gifts the LORD gives as the bride-price. They also describe the kind of husband he will be. Both senses fit, and the translation keeps the simple "in" at Literal and "with" at Balanced.

decisions.choice: loyal love (*hesed*) and compassion: the covenant love that keeps faith, and tender mercy
decisions.reason: *Hesed* is the faithful love that keeps a commitment. Compassion is the word in the daughter's name No Compassion (1:6): what was withheld is now given as a wedding gift.

decisions.choice: make you my bride (R); bring to our marriage what is right and fair (R); faithful love (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says "make you my bride" for "betroth", which is not a common word today. It says "bring to our marriage" so as to keep both senses of m2, and "what is right and fair" for righteousness and justice. *Hesed* is "faithful love" at Readable, as set for the prophets.

decisions.choice: "amor leal" (L); "amor fiel" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Hesed as in the Spanish prophets and Psalms.

decisions.choice: "te desposaré conmigo"
decisions.reason: The word for the binding promise that begins a marriage; "desposar" keeps it at Literal and Balanced, and Readable says "te haré mi esposa". The span on "conmigo" is not possible, since the pronoun is joined to the preposition.

decisions.choice: "je te fiancerai à moi" (L), "je ferai de toi ma fiancée" (B), "je ferai de toi ma femme" (R); hesed "l'amour loyal" (L), "l'amour fidèle" (B, R), throughout Hosea
decisions.reason: The betrothal binds as a marriage; Balanced keeps the betrothal in an ordinary phrase and Readable names the marriage, as the English Readable "bride" does. Hesed follows the term sheet: French Balanced says "amour fidèle" where the English Balanced says "loyal love", as published Isaiah and the Psalms.

decisions.choice: "hứa hôn" (L); "cưới ... làm vợ" (B, R); hesed "tình yêu thương thành tín" (L, B), "tình thương không hề thay đổi" (R)
decisions.reason: "Hứa hôn" is the word for the binding betrothal at Literal; Balanced and Readable say what it amounts to, marriage. Hesed takes the prophets' wording from the terms note, kept apart from "lòng thương xót" (rachamim).

decisions.choice: "의와 정의" (L, B), "옳고 바른 일" (R); *hesed* "한결같은 사랑" (L, B), "변함없는 사랑" (R); *rachamim* "긍휼" (L, B), "자비" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms settled for the prophets. *Hesed* keeps one wording through Hosea (6:4, 6; 10:12; 12:7) so the theme can be followed.

decisions.choice: *hesed* "upendo usiokoma"
decisions.reason: At every level, as in Isaiah, Jeremiah and the Psalms (term sheet); recorded once for Hosea and Joel.

decisions.choice: "nitakuposa" (I will betroth you)
decisions.reason: "Kuposa" is to ask for and bind a bride in the agreement that begins a marriage (m1). Readable says "nitakufanya uwe bibi arusi wangu", as the English "make you my bride".

source.text: וְאֵרַשְׂתִּ֥יךְ לִ֖י בֶּאֱמוּנָ֑ה וְיָדַ֖עַתְּ אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And I will betroth you to me in faithfulness, and you will know Yahweh.

en.L: And I will betroth you to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} in faithfulness, \q and you will know {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: I will betroth you to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} with faithfulness, \q and you will know {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: I will make you {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} bride, and I will be faithful to you, \q and you will know {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y te desposaré conmigo en fidelidad, \q y conocerás {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Te desposaré conmigo con fidelidad, \q y conocerás {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Te haré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} esposa, y te seré fiel, \q y conocerás {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et je te fiancerai à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} par la fidélité, \q et tu connaîtras {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Je ferai de toi {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fiancée par la fidélité, \q et tu connaîtras {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Je ferai de toi {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} femme, et je te serai fidèle, \q et tu connaîtras {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

ko.L: 내가 신실함으로 너와 약혼하겠다. \q 그러면 너는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 알 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 신실함으로 너를 아내로 맞겠다. \q 그러면 너는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 알게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 너를 내 신부로 삼고, 너에게 신실하겠다. \q 그러면 너는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 알게 될 것이다.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ hứa hôn ngươi cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong sự thành tín, \q và ngươi sẽ biết {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Ta sẽ cưới con làm vợ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bằng sự thành tín, \q và con sẽ biết {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Ta sẽ cưới con làm vợ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ luôn thành tín với con, \q và con sẽ biết {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

sw.L: Nami nitakuposa uwe {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kwa uaminifu, \q nawe utamjua {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Nitakuposa uwe {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kwa uaminifu, \q nawe utamjua {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Nitakufanya uwe bibi arusi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitakuwa mwaminifu kwako, \q nawe utamjua {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: faithfulness: the LORD's steady reliability
decisions.reason: The word means firmness, reliability, keeping one's word. It is the third gift of the betrothal: the LORD will be utterly dependable.

decisions.choice: you will know the LORD: you will acknowledge him and live in close relationship with him
decisions.reason: This answers 2:10, "she did not know that I gave her the grain". In Hosea, knowing the LORD means recognizing him, trusting him, and living by his covenant (4:1, 6; 6:3, 6). The word is also used for the closeness of husband and wife, which suits the marriage picture.

decisions.choice: make you my bride, and I will be faithful to you
decisions.reason: Readable says "make you my bride", as in 2:21, and turns "in faithfulness" into a statement of what the LORD will be (m1).

source.text: וְהָיָ֣ה׀בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא אֶֽעֱנֶה֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה אֶעֱנֶ֖ה אֶת־הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְהֵ֖ם יַעֲנ֥וּ אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be in the day the that, I will answer, declaration of Yahweh, I will answer the heavens, and they will answer the earth.

en.L: And it will be on that day [that] I will answer, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q I will answer the heavens, \q and they will answer the earth.
en.B: On that day I will answer, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q I will answer the heavens, \q and they will answer the earth.
en.R: At that time I will answer, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q I will answer the sky, \q and the sky will answer the earth.

es.L: Y sucederá en aquel día [que] yo responderé, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q responderé a los cielos, \q y ellos responderán a la tierra.
es.B: Aquel día yo responderé, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Responderé a los cielos, \q y ellos responderán a la tierra.
es.R: En ese tiempo yo responderé, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Responderé al cielo, \q y el cielo responderá a la tierra.

fr.L: Et il arrivera en ce jour-là [que] je répondrai, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q je répondrai aux cieux, \q et eux répondront à la terre.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, je répondrai, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Je répondrai aux cieux, \q et ils répondront à la terre.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, je répondrai, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Je répondrai au ciel, \q et le ciel répondra à la terre.

ko.L: 그날에 이렇게 될 것이다. 내가 응답하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. \q 내가 하늘에 응답하고, \q 하늘은 땅에 응답할 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에 내가 응답하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 내가 하늘에 응답하고, \q 하늘은 땅에 응답할 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에 나는 응답하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 나는 하늘에 응답하고, \q 하늘은 땅에 응답할 것이다.

vi.L: Và sẽ xảy ra trong ngày ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đáp lời, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đáp lời các tầng trời, \q và chúng sẽ đáp lời đất.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đáp lời, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy. \q Ta sẽ đáp lời các tầng trời, \q và các tầng trời sẽ đáp lời đất.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đáp lời, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. \q Ta sẽ đáp lời bầu trời, \q và bầu trời sẽ đáp lời mặt đất.

sw.L: Na itakuwa katika siku ile [kwamba] nitajibu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q nitazijibu mbingu, \q nazo zitaijibu nchi.
sw.B: Siku hiyo nitajibu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Nitazijibu mbingu, \q nazo zitaijibu ardhi.
sw.R: Wakati huo nitajibu, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Nitaijibu anga, \q nayo anga itaijibu ardhi.

decisions.choice: a chain of answers: the LORD answers the sky, the sky answers the earth with rain
decisions.reason: The verse begins a chain that runs to 2:24: the LORD answers the heavens, the heavens give rain to the earth, the earth gives grain, wine and oil, and these answer Jezreel, the people. Each one responds to the need of the next. The rain and harvest that the people sought from Baal (2:7, 10) come from the LORD.

decisions.choice: answer (L, B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb "answer" is kept at every level through 2:23-24, so that the chain can be seen. Readable says "sky" for "heavens" and repeats "the sky" for "they".

decisions.choice: "kujibu" (answer) through the chain
decisions.reason: One verb for every link in the chain (m1), so that each answer is heard as the same act; "kuitikia" (respond) is kept for Israel's response in 2:17.

source.text: וְהָאָ֣רֶץ תַּעֲנֶ֔ה אֶת־הַדָּגָ֖ן וְאֶת־הַתִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְאֶת־הַיִּצְהָ֑ר וְהֵ֖ם יַעֲנ֥וּ אֶֽת־יִזְרְעֶֽאל׃

records.literal_gloss: And the earth will answer the grain and the new wine and the fresh oil, and they will answer Jezreel.

en.L: And the earth will answer the grain and the new wine and the fresh oil, \q and they will answer Jezreel.
en.B: The earth will answer the grain, the new wine, and the olive oil, \q and they will answer Jezreel.
en.R: The earth will answer the grain, the wine, and the olive oil, \q and they will answer Jezreel, the people God plants.

es.L: Y la tierra responderá al grano, al mosto y al aceite fresco, \q y ellos responderán a Jezreel.
es.B: La tierra responderá al grano, al vino nuevo y al aceite de oliva, \q y ellos responderán a Jezreel.
es.R: La tierra responderá al grano, al vino y al aceite de oliva, \q y ellos responderán a Jezreel, el pueblo que Dios siembra.

fr.L: Et la terre répondra au blé et au vin nouveau et à l’huile fraîche, \q et eux répondront à Jizreël.
fr.B: La terre répondra au blé, au vin nouveau et à l’huile, \q et ils répondront à Jizreël.
fr.R: La terre répondra au blé, au vin et à l’huile d’olive, \q et ils répondront à Jizreël, le peuple que Dieu plante.

ko.L: 땅은 곡식과 새 포도주와 햇기름에 응답하고, \q 그것들은 이스르엘에 응답할 것이다.
ko.B: 땅은 곡식과 새 포도주와 기름에 응답하고, \q 그것들은 이스르엘에 응답할 것이다.
ko.R: 땅은 곡식과 포도주와 올리브기름에 응답하고, \q 그것들은 하나님께서 심으시는 백성인 이스르엘에 응답할 것이다.

vi.L: Và đất sẽ đáp lời ngũ cốc, rượu mới và dầu mới, \q và chúng sẽ đáp lời Gít-rê-ên.
vi.B: Đất sẽ đáp lời ngũ cốc, rượu mới và dầu ô-liu, \q và chúng sẽ đáp lời Gít-rê-ên.
vi.R: Mặt đất sẽ đáp lời ngũ cốc, rượu và dầu ô-liu, \q và chúng sẽ đáp lời Gít-rê-ên, là dân được Đức Chúa Trời gieo trồng.

sw.L: Nayo nchi itaijibu nafaka na divai mpya na mafuta mapya, \q navyo vitamjibu Yezreeli.
sw.B: Ardhi itaijibu nafaka, divai mpya na mafuta, \q navyo vitamjibu Yezreeli.
sw.R: Ardhi itaijibu nafaka, divai na mafuta ya zeituni, \q navyo vitamjibu Yezreeli, watu ambao Mungu anawapanda.

decisions.choice: Jezreel: "God sows", now a name of blessing for the people
decisions.reason: In 1:4 Jezreel named a place of bloodshed. Here it names the people as those whom God sows like seed, and the next verse continues the picture: "I will sow her for myself in the land". The harvest answers them.

decisions.choice: the grain, the new wine and the fresh oil: the gifts of 2:10 restored
decisions.reason: The same three gifts the woman did not know came from the LORD (2:10), and that he took back (2:11), are given again.

decisions.choice: the people God plants
decisions.reason: Readable gives the meaning of the name in the text, since it carries the promise and leads into 2:25 (m1). Literal and Balanced keep the name with a footnote.

source.text: וּזְרַעְתִּ֤יהָ לִּי֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ וְרִֽחַמְתִּ֖י אֶת־לֹ֣א רֻחָ֑מָה וְאָמַרְתִּ֤י לְלֹֽא־עַמִּי֙ עַמִּי־אַ֔תָּה וְה֖וּא יֹאמַ֥ר אֱלֹהָֽי׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And I will sow her for myself in the land, and I will have compassion on Lo-ruhamah, and I will say to Lo-ammi, My people [are] you, and he will say, My God.

en.L: And I will sow her for {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} in the land, \q and I will have compassion on Lo-ruhamah, \q and I will say to Lo-ammi, "My people [are] you," \q and he will say, "My God."
en.B: I will sow her for {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} in the land. \q I will have compassion on No Compassion, \q and I will say to Not My People, "You are {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people," \q and he will say, "You are my God."
en.R: I will plant her in the land for {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}}. \q I will show compassion to No Compassion. \q I will say to Not My People, "You are {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people." \q And he will say, "You are my God."

es.L: Y la sembraré para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} en la tierra, \q y tendré compasión de Lo-ruhama, \q y diré a Lo-ammi: «Mi pueblo [eres] tú», \q y él dirá: «Dios mío».
es.B: La sembraré para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} en la tierra. \q Tendré compasión de No Compadecida, \q y diré a No Es Mi Pueblo: «Tú eres {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo», \q y él dirá: «Tú eres mi Dios».
es.R: La plantaré en la tierra para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. \q Tendré compasión de No Compadecida. \q Le diré a No Es Mi Pueblo: «Tú eres {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo». \q Y él dirá: «Tú eres mi Dios».

fr.L: Et je la sèmerai pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} dans le pays, \q et j’aurai compassion de Lo-Rouhama, \q et je dirai à Lo-Ammi : « Mon peuple, [c’est] toi », \q et lui dira : « Mon Dieu ».
fr.B: Je la sèmerai pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} dans le pays. \q J’aurai compassion de Sans-Compassion, \q et je dirai à Pas-Mon-Peuple : « Tu es {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple », \q et il dira : « Tu es mon Dieu. »
fr.R: Je la planterai pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} dans le pays. \q J’aurai de la compassion pour Sans-Compassion. \q Je dirai à Pas-Mon-Peuple : « Tu es {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple. » \q Et il dira : « Tu es mon Dieu. »

ko.L: 내가 그 여자를 나를 위하여 이 땅에 뿌리고, \q 로루하마를 긍휼히 여기고, \q 로암미에게 "너는 내 백성이다" 하고 말하겠다. \q 그러면 그가 "나의 하나님" 하고 말할 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 그 여자를 나를 위하여 이 땅에 씨 뿌리듯 심겠다. \q '긍휼 없음'을 긍휼히 여기고, \q '내 백성 아님'에게 "너는 내 백성이다" 하고 말하겠다. \q 그러면 그가 "주님은 저의 하나님이십니다" 하고 대답할 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 그 여자를 나를 위하여 이 땅에 심겠다. \q '긍휼 없음'을 긍휼히 여기겠다. \q '내 백성 아님'에게 "너는 내 백성이다" 하고 말하겠다. \q 그러면 그가 "주님은 저의 하나님이십니다" 하고 대답할 것이다.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ gieo nàng cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong xứ, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ thương xót Lô-Ru-ha-ma, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ nói với Lô-Am-mi: "Ngươi [là] dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}," \q và người ấy sẽ nói: "Đức Chúa Trời của tôi."
vi.B: Ta sẽ gieo trồng nàng cho chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong xứ. \q Ta sẽ thương xót Không Được Thương Xót, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ nói với Không Phải Dân Ta: "Con là dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}," \q và người ấy sẽ thưa: "Ngài là Đức Chúa Trời của con."
vi.R: Ta sẽ trồng nàng trong xứ cho chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Ta sẽ thương xót Không Được Thương Xót. \q Ta sẽ nói với Không Phải Dân Ta: "Con là dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}." \q Và người ấy sẽ thưa: "Ngài là Đức Chúa Trời của con."

sw.L: Nami nitampanda kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} katika nchi, \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitamhurumia Lo-ruhama, \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitamwambia Lo-ami, "Watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} [ni] ninyi," \q naye atasema, "Mungu wangu."
sw.B: Nitampanda kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} katika nchi. \q Nitamhurumia Asiyehurumiwa, \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitamwambia Si Watu Wangu, "Ninyi ni watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}," \q naye atasema, "Wewe ni Mungu wangu."
sw.R: Nitampanda katika nchi kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. \q Nitamhurumia Asiyehurumiwa. \q Nitamwambia Si Watu Wangu, "Ninyi ni watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}." \q Naye atasema, "Wewe ni Mungu wangu."

decisions.choice: I will sow her: a play on the name Jezreel, "God sows"
decisions.reason: The verb is the one in the name Jezreel (2:24). "Her" is the woman of the poem, the people, planted in the land like seed that will grow. Jeremiah 31:27 uses the same picture of sowing the house of Israel.

decisions.choice: Lo-ruhamah, Lo-ammi: the names of 1:6 and 1:9, now reversed
decisions.reason: The daughter named "Not Shown Compassion" receives compassion, and the son named "Not My People" is told "You are my people". The names stay, but what they said is undone.

decisions.choice: Romans 9:25 and 1 Peter 2:10 use this promise
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this verse, freely, in Romans 9:25, in the form "I will call those who were not my people 'my people,' and her who was not loved 'loved'". His wording follows the Greek Old Testament, which here has "loved" in some copies where the Hebrew has "shown compassion", and he applies the promise to Gentiles as well as Jews. 1 Peter 2:10 speaks to believers in the words of this verse: once not a people and not shown mercy, now God's people and shown mercy. In Hosea the promise is first spoken to Israel.

decisions.choice: you are my people ... my God: the covenant words restored
decisions.reason: 1:9 denied both halves of the covenant promise (Leviticus 26:12). Here both are spoken again, the LORD's "my people" and the people's answer "my God". Zechariah 13:9 ends with the same exchange.

decisions.choice: No Compassion; Not My People (B, R); Lo-ruhamah; Lo-ammi (L)
decisions.reason: The names are translated at Balanced and Readable and kept in Hebrew at Literal, as in chapter 1. Balanced and Readable supply "You are" before "my God", which the Hebrew leaves out.

decisions.choice: plant
decisions.reason: Readable says "plant" for "sow", a word it uses for seeds and young plants alike, and keeps the link to "the people God plants" in 2:24.

decisions.choice: "Tú eres mi pueblo"; "Tú eres mi Dios"
decisions.reason: Romans 9:25 and 1 Peter 2:10 use this promise; the Spanish keeps their key words ("mi pueblo", "compasión") while following the Hebrew, which speaks to one child in the singular.

decisions.choice: "«Mi pueblo [eres] tú»"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew order, which puts "my people" first, against the "not my people" of 1:9.

decisions.choice: "Lô-Ru-ha-ma", "Lô-Am-mi" (L); "Không Được Thương Xót", "Không Phải Dân Ta" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here still has the names with "not", which God now overturns, so the Vietnamese keeps them as in 1:6 and 1:9, as the English does; the new names of 2:3 are not used in this verse.

decisions.choice: "Con là dân Ta"; "Ngài là Đức Chúa Trời của con"
decisions.reason: In the tender passage God says "con" at Balanced and Readable, and the people answer God with "con" and "Ngài", as the prophets' prayers do; the sentence-initial "Ngài" takes no span.

decisions.choice: The people answer God in 합쇼체: "주님은 저의 하나님이십니다" (B, R); L keeps the bare "나의 하나님"
decisions.reason: People speak to God in 합쇼체; the Balanced and Readable answer is a full sentence, as the English "You are my God".

decisions.choice: "ninyi" (you, plural) for the Hebrew singular "you"
decisions.reason: Swahili cannot call one person "watu" (people), so the words are addressed to the people the child stands for, as Romans 9:25 and 1 Peter 2:10 have them; "naye atasema" keeps the Hebrew singular for the answer.
